# Code provisions \- audit committee in Hong Kong
### Chapter 3, section 3\.21 of the Main Board Listing Rules requires:
'Every listed issuer must establish an audit committee comprising non\-executive directors only\. The audit committee must comprise a minimum of three members, at least one of whom is an INED with appropriate professional qualifications or accounting or related financial management expertise as required under rule 3\.10\(2\)\. The majority of the audit committee members must be independent non\-executive directors of the listed issuer\. The audit committee must be chaired by an independent non\-executive director\.'

The GEM Board \(Growth Enterprise Market\) has similar requirements in Chapter 5, Section 5\.28 covering Audit Committees\.

For further assistance the HKICPA \(formerly known as the Hong Kong Society of Accountants\) published in February 2002, 'A Guide for Effective Audit Committees'\. Listed issuers may refer to the terms of reference set out in this Guide, or they may adopt any other comparable terms of reference for the establishment of an audit committee\.
### The main role and responsibilities should be set out in written terms of reference and should include:
\(a\) To ~monitor the integrity of the financial statements~ of the company and any formal announcements relating to the company's financial performance, reviewing significant financial reporting issues and judgments contained in them\.

The audit committee should review arrangements by which staff of the company may, in confidence, **raise concerns about possible improprieties** in matters of financial reporting or other matters\. The audit committee's objective should be to ensure that arrangements are in place for the proportionate and ~independent investigation~ of such matters and for appropriate follow\-up action\.

The terms of reference of the audit committee, including its role and the authority delegated to it by the board, should be made available\. A separate section of the annual report should describe the work of the committee in discharging those responsibilities\.

\(b\) To review the company's ~internal financial controls~ and, unless expressly addressed by a separate board risk committee composed of independent directors or by the board itself, the company's internal control and risk management systems\.

\(c\) To ~monitor~ and review the effectiveness of the company's **internal audit function\.**

Where there is no internal audit function, the audit committee should consider annually whether there is a need for an internal audit function and make a recommendation to the board, and the reasons for the absence of such a function should be explained in the relevant section of the annual report\.

\(d\) To make recommendations to the board on the ~appointment, reappointment and removal~ of the **external auditors,** to approve the remuneration and terms of engagement of the external auditors and any questions of resignation or dismissal of the external auditors \(section C\.3\.3\(a\) of Appendix 14\)\.

If the board does not accept the audit committee's recommendation, it should include in the annual report, and in any papers recommending appointment or re\-appointment, a statement from the audit committee explaining the recommendation and should set out reasons why the board has taken a different position\.

\(e\) To monitor and review the ​**external auditors**​' ~independence, objectivity and effectiveness~ of the audit process in accordance with applicable standards \(section C\.3\.3\(b\) of Appendix 14\)\. To ~seek information from the external auditors~ on an annual basis on the external auditors' processes for maintaining independence and monitoring compliance with relevant requirements, including any applicable requirement on rotation of engagement team members\.

\(f\) To develop and implement policy on engagement of the external auditor to supply ​**non\-audit services**​, taking into account relevant ethical guidance regarding the provisions of non\-audit services by the external audit firm and to report to the board, identifying any matters in respect of which it considers that action or improvement is needed, and making recommendations as to the steps to be taken \(section C\.3\.3\(c\) of Appendix 14\)\.

\(g\) An audit committee should **meet** the external auditor at least twice a year\.

\(h\) To ensure co\-ordination between the internal audit function \(where it exists\) and the external auditors\.

\(i\) To review the external auditors' management letter, any material queries raised by the external auditors to management in respect of the accounting records, financial statements or systems of control and management's response\.

\(j\) An audit committee's terms of reference should include arrangements for employees to raise ~concerns about financial reporting improprieties~\.

\(k\) A RBP recommends the audit committee establish a whistleblowing policy and system\.

entries.text:
# advantages and drawbacks of audit committees
The **advantages** of having an audit committee are as follows:
\(a\) To improve the quality of financial reporting, by reviewing the financial statements on behalf of the board\.
\(b\) To create an ethical environment and establish controls which will act as a deterrent and reduce the opportunity for fraud\.
\(c\) To enable the non\-executive directors to inject their experience, expertise and an independent judgment into the entity's affairs\.
\(d\) To help the Chief Financial Officer, by providing a forum in which he can raise matters of concern, and a mechanism for resolving potentially difficult issues\.
\(e\) To work with and improve the quality and efficiency of the external auditor, by providing a means of communication and apparatus to resolve issues of concern\.
\(f\) To provide a framework within which the external auditor can assert his position in the event of a dispute with management\.
\(g\) To strengthen the status of the internal audit function, by providing a greater degree of independence from management\.
\(h\) To increase public confidence in the reliability and objectivity of financial statements\.
### Opponents of audit committees argue the following:
\(a\) The executive directors may not understand the purpose of an audit committee and may perceive that it detracts from their authority\.
\(b\) There may be difficulty selecting sufficient non\-executive directors with the necessary competence in auditing matters for the committee to be really effective\.
\(c\) The establishment of such a formalised reporting procedure may dissuade the auditors from raising matters of judgment and limit them to reporting only on matters of fact; and
\(d\) Costs may be increased\.

(c) The establishment of such a formalised reporting procedure may dissuade the auditors from raising matters of judgment and limit them to reporting only on matters of fact; and
(d) Costs may be increased.

entries.text:
# CGR self\-test 3
Peace Limited is a company listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and has entered into an agreement with Mr\. Chan, an executive director of Peace Limited, for consultancy services\. Pursuant to the agreement, Peace Limited will pay HK$10 million to Mr\. Chan for general consultancy services such as promoting the image of Peace Limited in the market\.

Required

Suggest the corporate governance measures required \(ignoring the Hong Kong Listing Rules requirements on connected transactions\) to enhance the transparency of transactions with directors in Peace Limited\.
## \(8 marks\) HKICPA June 2014 \(amended\)
## Answer
The Hong Kong Stock Exchange sets out the principles of good corporate governance in the Corporate Governance Code \('the Code'\) included in the Appendix of the Main Board Listing Rules\. The recommended corporate governance measures Peace Limited should consider include:
### Composition and balance of the board of directors
A single individual may bypass the board to action his own interest\. The board should include directors with proper knowledge and experience in assessing the reasonableness of material transactions entered into by Peace Limited\. The mix between executive and independent nonexecutive director should also be balanced to allow a proper review of management activities\.
### Audit committee
Peace Limited is a company listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange\. It must establish an audit committee according to the listing rules\. An audit committee should be established to review Peace Limited's internal financial controls\. The Code has already a requirement that the Audit Committee should be independent from the management\. The committee should also be kept abreast of the information and developments in Peace Limited's as a monitoring measure against contract with directors\.
### Remuneration Committee
The Code requires the establishment of a Remuneration Committee, consisting of the majority of independent executive directors, to approve the remuneration of directors and executives\. A reasonable remuneration package for the management is usually a general measure to prevent senior management from acting for self\-interest or committing wrong\-doings at the expense of the company's interest\.
### Other measures
Typical corporate governance measures also include an employee whistle\-blowing scheme where employees are encouraged to report exceptional or suspicious related party activities e\.g\. fraud or collusion and corporate governance issues\. Peace Limited should consider establishing such a communication channel\.

# New Case from Logitech \- getting much better now

This one is much more preferable than the one from Apple\. 
It is more flexible, durable, and economic\. 

I have been waiting for this keyboard for a long time\. Because i like to one did by Logitech\. For iPad Pro 9\.7\. When I had a try to other apple keyboard, they just not match my expectation\.

I have been giving up hope that Logitech would not be able to use smart connector\. But now it can\. It is really fantastic\!\!


I don’t have to use another battery\. To be afraid of lost connection because of no Bluetooth connection\. And Bluetooth is not quick enough I believe\.

I think I would use this iPad much more often than the past\. Because writing is now much more convenient\. 

No matter it is for work or daily life journal or anything\.

The QP exam will be on schedule
https://app\.sparkmailapp\.com/web\-share/HCEku2UFrL2aC8ks6Kg1MyXUfZJMP3ywVJ2imnE0

I would pass it no matter what\. Together with completing the work properly\.

No matter what I face\. I won’t give up\.

Just so good that I think I 	like to from the bottom of my heart\.

During the day, during the night, doing good or bad\.

---

I like how the Logitech Folio Touch function in the way it is\. It is quick and nice\.
It is more than enough as a case\. It is much cheaper\. Cost $1399 vs Apple Magic Keyboard $2299\.

Now i can type anywhere I want\.

I can even type in my room comfortably\. Very good\. 

I want to be more focused\. So Don’t visit YouTube so often\. To be a strong man\.

---

While I’m writing\. I know that I am thinking about the study

Inventory \- HKAS 2, audit
HKAS 2 \- valuation, min\(cost, NRV\), slow moving item, obsolete

---

Vague accusation

entries.text:
# Reason of giving up \-> change
Because it is boring\. Comparing to the stories and news which is easily accessible, all those targets, required energy, hard work\. My brain will heart would fell that it is difficult, so it would like to get the pleasure, not the pressure\. 
it is normal to human being\. That’s why so little people can achieve great\. Many people just waste their life\. I’m now 37 years old\. Turning to be 38\. It is not an overstatement that I don’t have much time if I don’t change my thinking now\. 
### How to change? 
Set long term target, mid term and short term\. And also steps\. So that goals become attainable again\. 
Believe that my life could be greater than the stories\. Write it down my experience and share it\. Help people in the process\.

### Night 
now that I don’t need to watch TV, I can choose to take 105 Minibus and the\. Walk to home from Po Lam\. It is a balance between time and exercise\. 

I think in the past to use Roam to type diary, but it is slow and not beautiful\. I wish Roam could improve quickly and prove an App version in iOS\. 

When I’m home\. I spent most of the time on watching YouTube and Manga, That’s a waste of time\. Only a small portion was spent on study\. That’s far from enough\. I have to be more focused So that I can achieve more and become the person I want to be\. 

I know that diary is better to be in a separate app\.

I’m on the 290X bus now\. Not everything could be changed immediately\. I need to imagine\. Need to prepare\. 

Faster to type with keyboard\. I know that I shall have a decision\. Otherwise, I would always be stuck to here\. Can’t go anywhere\. 

Art, Code, Investment, Connecting the dots\. Contribute something to people around me, and the world\. 

### On the way home
Taking minibus again\. It’s quick\. I’m thinking hours to make good use of the back tapping\. What do I often do with my phone?

# Not a productive day
I planned to do enough for the day, but could only did part of one item\.

![](dayone-moment://81EB648B911A4ADA98E74B2DCB07D90F)

During the day, I spent a long time to read manga, “One Punch Man”\. But it’s meaningless to me\. 

Only at the night, I tried to focus, bit still distracted\.

# World is changing \- street cleaning machine
I thought it was wasteful to clean the street with spate water, and also inconvenient as people would passing the street\. It needs to have a number of people to manage it\. 

Even such little would change\. How about me? Would I only be a person to adapt the changes? Or lead the world?

---

At the end of the day, I would like to play tai chi, resume the habit I had for years in the past\. Before that I want to summarize what I learn during the day, so that I can accumulate what I learnt\.

Focus on the habit not the goal

# Hiking in the morning to Ma On Shan

![](dayone-moment://A7505B09FA764FC2892FA014EE33AC8F)

![](dayone-moment://AEE20C39F07F4815803A8BA487FC463D)

![](dayone-moment://030C2D547DBF4872A8EA6ED490629393)

![](dayone-moment://313047B0A175406F9B56BEC88B297B37)

This morning weather was nice\. So as scheduled, I went running on the mountain\. 
https://connect\.garmin\.com/modern/activity/6082582302

During the running, I finished the book “Atomic Habit”\. Similar to other book it tell us how to transform ourselves with habits\.
- Make it easy for good habits, Make it difficult for bad habits \-> make it right after you; have a clear steps etc\. 
- Focus on the improvement of system, not the results\. 
- To not get bored\. After getting used to it, introduce some challenge\. Not to far away

It took 3 hours to finish it\. Around 5min better than last time\. Which I took shortcuts\. So it should be 15mins better\. 

https://connect\.garmin\.com/modern/activity/6039346925

Then Kammy and I ate at We Go shopping mall, Blue Bird\. I ate eel\.

After that we walk to a bus station through a wet market\. It was big\.
 
I took 89D and 98A to home\. Slept during the travel\.

When I was home, I watched the Korean drama, True Beauty\.

If I read so many, but not change, it is a waste of time\.

# Hiking from Pak Tam Au to Hoi Ha
星期五晚上工作直至零晨3:45am\. 終於可以專心完成OTT SG TB 2020, can provide it to auditor\.
I got a lots of disturbance during the week\. Only until the weekend I could start on it\. It was not as difficult as expected\. 

Since I expected today weather was good, so I asked Kammy to go hiking somewhere\. 
When I woke up this morning, the first trail came to my view was to 雞麻峒 https://www\.oasistrek\.com/kai\_ma\_tung\.php\.

![](dayone-moment://8DFEB6C1622A4D81AF5801D893367D39)

*Saw a boar when I heading to the minibus station\.*

I went out at around 11am\. Took no\. 1A minibus at Cheng Lan Shui\. The trip including 25min walking was around 45 min\.

The weather as expected was beautiful\.

![](dayone-moment://417F8022AEE7465DBE728240A5A5D936)

We took no\. 94 bus to Pak Tam Au, then through Cheung Sheung, to the route we intend to go this time\. The new route include
- 石屋山 > 蛇石坳 › 雞麻峒 › 白角仔 › 荔枝莊 › 南山洞 › 白沙澳

![](dayone-moment://C0412307A4944DAE94696E1133B1427E)

I like this tree at Cheung Sheung\. It is big in this type of tree\.

However, we took the wrong route\. Could only reached 石屋山\. Then we went to Hoi Ha when we left the mountain\.

![](dayone-moment://C2C10F5E46FC48EE9348934651800D09)

We took some photos at the helicopter site at 石屋山\. It is beautiful\. The sky was blue\.

Although we didn’t go to the places we intended to go, the view at Hoi Ha was beautiful\. It is not contaminated by Human\. Water was very clean and clear\.

![](dayone-moment://64172FE308834EB2BFE3E599B08F4774)

We had a tea at a cafe called 好景茶座\. The foods were not very good\. But it was the only choice\. It is good enough\. 

After a walk at the seafront, we took minibus no\. 7 to Sai Kung Pier and then went home separately\.

entries.text:
# Sick \- vomited and tired
At the afternoon, when I slept in front of my desk, I suddenly felt my feet were cold\. Then didn’t feel comfortable for the whole afternoon\. Intended to play tai chi, but couldn’t muster the energy\. However, still want to buy a switch for my computers\. So I took bus to Kwun Tong\. The price was $125\. I felt that I wanted to vomit\. So I quickly return home\.

![](dayone-moment://32C3899381CE41F8A4450028159A6021)

Hoi arrived, and get some of his photos backup\. I just wanted to rest\. 

I slept from 9pm to this morning around 8am\. 

I have to make my body strong again\. To have more regular lifestyle\. Don’t exhaust myself\. Do keep on absorbing information, entertainment\.from: 

![](dayone-moment://60CBE406867749CFB5024636F9CFDD9F)

# Royal view 

![](dayone-moment://806E0020DCAA48A6BEB1F903D345E1E7)

The interface of the app make me want to type more than notion\. 

We went to Royal View hotel after the busy weeks for year\-end\.  It is a leisure weekend\. 

I ordered pizza hut while I was at 290x going to Tsuen Wan\. It was around $200\. 

We intended to have double beds, but not available\. So the receptionist upgrade us to 2 large beds room\. We could see the magnificent Tsing Ma Bridges views\.

![](dayone-moment://0FD7831087334023A530F689F191CE82)

![](dayone-moment://41B60725BCFE465CB2B5E0157828B748)

We would have breakfast at Sum Cheng, then an easy hike\. 

When I were sleeping\. I suddenly thought of Shawshank Redemption\. Prisoner of my thoughts\. People have free mind, but because of environment, they tend to fix on what they have been doing or thinking\. If context never change, nothing would be changed\.

entries.text:
# Saturday hike

![](dayone-moment://33736E60BD5F49B9B70B3B1960830799)

In the morning, we walked from the hotel to Sum Tseng to have breakfast at 陳記粉麵\. It has good milk tea\. Price is economic\. Around $35 for breakfast\. I had egg and sausage, bread plus macaroni\. As usual, I drank lemon water\. 

The seats were full, we waited for a short time\. 

After that we bought 2 breads nearby\. 

We went to toilet before the hike\. 

喜香農莊, built in 2002\. Saw many flowers and plant\.  I saw a man circling a peach blossom\. We walked around the farm\.

![](dayone-moment://2642289DD32E4B4CAFFAEBBC93D0216F)

![](dayone-moment://79AA1787E8D34F6DA66D790D3EDFDA4D)

Saw beautiful decoration, like lamp bulb\. 2 dogs were sleeping on the ground lazily\.

![](dayone-moment://ABF2BFBC09DF45119A15476026525517)

![](dayone-moment://C689F9AD0E744DC2B5D301C31CFB625E)

We noticed that there are a bunch of 吊鐘花 already blossom\. They are beautiful\. But I couldn’t reach there\.

![](dayone-moment://F97B4B51AA924CADA3517E7BABCF4830)

We went to 石龍拱\. Have a rest and some bread\. Then left around 3:30 pm\.

![](dayone-moment://2C69CBBD6E8146208C7FE1C9FA0C4824)

The leaving way has a long stairs to go down\. We decent around 港安醫院\. And saw a big 榕樹, spread for a large area\.

![](dayone-moment://CAE66C818E69464B9766E42A69DEF9E0)

Passing that then arrived the road very soon\. We reached 麗城花園, had tea at a place call \.\.\. don’t remember the name \(燉奶佬\)\. I ate 渣渣 and dumpling macaroni\. Very full after that\. I still have a bread in my bag\. 

Btw, the bag was heavy\. So we can’t walk faster or run\.

![](dayone-moment://3430771EB0D14F32B7B572F7956E4E59)

After that we walk to Tsuen Wan West\. Passing it to 楊屋道街市\. Wanted to find a daffodils buds\. Only found one store sold it at $30 for 2\. She didn’t buy it\. So we left and walked in the shopping mall\. 

I took 290X to home at around 6pm\. 

It is refreshed to have a bath after the hike\. I think during the bath that it could really because I kept on writing in the past that I succeeded in my study or work\. So it is the crucial step to learn and improve\. 

Only when I draw and write that make me feel that I’m empowered to change the world\. To communicate with myself

entries.text:
# Resting at home
To be empowered to improve\.

![](dayone-moment://CF9136E3D7F54C2682A7E9E2327AAF55)

I spent the day idling at home\.\.\. watch animation which I had watched\. But It is something that I decided not to continue\. 

Just like playing game, if we can raise the levels without fighting, we would not bother to train\. In daily life, if we can get the so\-called “entertainment” so easily\. We would not bother to get other entertainment\. No achievement seem to be important anymore\. But is it really what I want to get? I can get satisfaction \(or enjoyment\) easily but my heart still feel empty\.

![](dayone-moment://CF614979E48747B78BC89047F60B4E8C)

I want to train\. 
- Tai chi
- Art
- Coding
- Improving life

Today I had hair cut around 4pm\. Before CNY, I want to tidy up\.

# Writing journal with email

Can it help for my daily routine for work?

# Shall I email all to this place for my sending email?
Would it be information overloaded? If too much information , it would be time consuming to process it\. 

What is the status of creating bank account? What is the best routine for work and daily life? It shall be tried and error\. No perfect one, as life is changing everyday\.

Subject: FW: (Follow up) Viu HK Risk Assessment - seeking feedback
Importance: High

Hi all,

Fyi, Risk Management is conducting their risk assessment on HK Viu. Unfortunately, EBITDA is used the benchmark to assess the risk level…..but for Viu, a EBITDA loss business, we shall consider other benchmark like revenue, opex, cos or others !!

Please take a look

Thanks and regards,

Kenneth

From: Chan, Kenneth SC
Sent: Thursday, January 14, 2021 7:22 PM
To: Lee, Janice HY; Chan, Andrew J; Sou, Helen YK; Lo, Derrick KK (Digital Media)
Subject: FW: (Follow up) Viu HK Risk Assessment - seeking feedback
Importance: High

Hi Janice and Andrew,

Just a heads up. As you may recall, Risk Management visited nowTV mid last year and had vigorous discussions with Belinda and myself over the use of “EBITDA” or “Revenue” as the benchmark to assess our 3 LOBs (pay, free and OTT).

As that time, consensus was finally reached to use EBITDA to measure nowTV (stable and mature business), but changes have to be made when they assess Viu and ViuTV (business in early loss making investment phase) in the coming future.

Despite all these advance advices, Risk Management now come back and stick to their old rule (EBITDA) when they assess our Viu business. Given Viu’s EBITDA is still in red, we found the risk ratings are generally being inflated as compared to Revenue per our scenario analysis.

We have restated our stance, both Derrick and myself would also explore other alternatives with them before concluding a final risk assessment report to be submitted to the PCCW board. Will keep you all posted.

Thanks and regards,

Kenneth


From: Chan, Kenneth SC
Sent: Thursday, January 14, 2021 6:58 PM
To: Cheng, Benedict KF; Lo, Derrick KK (Digital Media); Leung, Kitty HK; Lau, Christine PY
Subject: RE: (Follow up) Viu HK Risk Assessment - seeking feedback

Hi Benedict,

Thanks. Discussed with management team in earlier stage, we hope all risks are properly and fairly be reflected and addressed. If we are well aware of the deficiency of the system design, shall be consider a better alternative (Revenue)?

Kindly note that “High” risk item increased from 3--> 5 (40% distortion) when EBITDA is selected as the basis for risk assessment, and we would expected more “High” risk item to be noted in coming years under the current setting.

Let’s discuss and explore if we shall present both findings in the report or if the risk rating be manually adjusted to show a fairer picture.

[cid:image002.png@01D6EAA7.24A21B90]

Thanks and regards,

Kenneth

From: Cheng, Benedict KF
Sent: Thursday, January 14, 2021 5:25 PM
To: Chan, Kenneth SC; Lo, Derrick KK (Digital Media); Leung, Kitty HK; Lau, Christine PY
Subject: RE: (Follow up) Viu HK Risk Assessment - seeking feedback

Referring to the comparison made over this particular assessment period, the two risk factors rated as “High” using EBITDA rather than Revenue were [04-02 Cyber Attack] and [08-21 Business Interruption]. Both of which aligned with the Group’s principle risks and were not peculiar to OTT as a business unit only given the continuous cyber security challenges/threats and pandemic conditions occurred during throughout the assessment period.

Moving forward, as we acknowledge that there are rooms for improvement on the financial impact benchmarking so that risk impacts of negatively performed businesses can be more appropriately assessed and reflected. Prior to the ERM system gets updated and that we can figure out a more precise methodology, it is of my view to adopt the same approach in deriving the corresponding risk ratings across all BU/FUs for the sake of good governance. Perhaps we could consider, for instance, taking an average of the negative EBITDAs for the past 3 years as opposed to just taking an absolute EBITDA of the previous year so that the fluctuation in EBITDA can be smoothened to a large extent in the next assessment cycle.

Hope this is acceptable to the business.

Happy to take this up with Janice and explain to her the rationale if needed.

Best,
Benedict
GRM&C intranet: http://intra.pccw.com/rm/index.html
“Risk Matters. Think Better.”

Dear Kenneth,

Per chat with Maggie on last Friday, you had the information on the EBITDA figure already. Regarding your question if the risk assessment report will be read by the senior management, it shouldn’t be a concern since this is our job to do analytic works behind to consolidate all data from BU/FUs instead of sending all risk assessments to the senior management to read. Each risk assessment shall be discussed and endorsed by the BU Head.

In the previous version of risk assessment, the business used rating 1 to 5 (minor to severe) to indicate the impact of the risk to their business. The rating itself is meaningless unless the business knows how to adjust it in each risk assessment period with the consideration of external and internal factors such as global and local economic situation, change of regulation, business’s P&L etc. Thus, we enhanced the impact rating scheme to a quantifiable way by using EBITDA of each business after discussion with Group Finance.

Let’s reinstate the reasons we use EBITDA instead of revenue in the impact quantification table by the below image:


<image001.jpg>
* Net income = Revenue – COS – Operating expenses – Other expenses – Interest – Taxes


One of the value-added elements to use EBITDA is to project how the profit-making ability of the business will be impacted by the risks.
If we use revenue (FY2018, PCCW Media’s revenue was HKD 3,969m; FY 2019, PCCW Media’s revenue is HKD 4,016m), the senior management of PCCW Media will see most of the risks related to revenue growing will be at a level of green.

Hence, below recap what Ophelia and us discussed about:


For a negative EBIDTA (75m) in the risk assessment period [01 July 2019 to 31 Dec 2019], for example, when PCCW Media raises a risk which has a financial exposure $1m on customer, it’s under score 2 (moderate) since this is 1.3% of that -75m EBIDTA.

What this means to PCCW Media? If this happens under a business who is losing money, they need to determine whether this risk imposes a more harmful situation to the business so that they need to do further mitigation action to minimize the loss. There may be another scenario like at the score 5, the business may still accept the risk after our advice since they may rather put the budget on the other areas or it’s not have much difference to lose a little bit more.



For a positive EBIDTA (5m) in the risk assessment period [01 Jan 2020 to 30 Jun 2020], yet, this $1m exposure will be under score 5 (extreme) since this is 20% of that +5m EBIDTA already.

What this means to PCCW Media? If this happens under a business that the EBITDA is growing (a youthful seedling period in this case), this $1m exposure will be ruined what PCCW Media’s profit making ability if this risk exposed. Hence, they need to think some mitigation actions even though the score is at 1 or 2 to protect what the business has built so far.



Conclusion:

When Belinda or Derrick walk through their risk assessment with Janice, they can interpret the above to let her understand.

Dear Ophelia,



It’s always efficient to have a chat to sort things out. Thanks for the call. Below is a recap of what we have discussed. In case you need our supplement when you discuss with Warwick and the Team, we are here to help anytime. Thanks.



Definition of Risk Materiality is defined as the measurement of impact severity and for PCCW is presented as various tranches to allow different risks to be compared quantitatively for severity.  It highlights why certain risks are more of less important for the company or business sector.  This will differ by Group, Entity and BU/FU based upon their financial capacity.



For a negative EBIDTA (75m) in the risk assessment period [01 July 2019 to 31 Dec 2019], for example, when PCCW Media raises a risk which has a financial exposure $1m on customer, it’s under score 2 (moderate) since this is 1.3% of that -75m EBIDTA.

What this means to PCCW Media? If this happens under a business who is losing money, they need to determine whether this risk imposes a more harmful situation to the business so that they need to do further mitigation action to minimize the loss. There may be another scenario like at the score 5, the business may still accept the risk after our advice since they may rather put the budget on the other areas or it’s not have much difference to lose a little bit more.



For a positive EBIDTA (5m) in the risk assessment period [01 Jan 2020 to 30 Jun 2020], yet, this $1m exposure will be under score 5 (extreme) since this is 20% of that +5m EBIDTA already.

What this means to PCCW Media? If this happens under a business that the EBITDA is growing (a youthful seedling period in this case), this $1m exposure will be ruined what PCCW Media has done in the past financial year if this risk exposed. Hence, they need to think some mitigation actions even though the score is at 1 or 2 to protect what the business has built so far.



Conclusion:

Janice should know this change in the EBIDTA due to performance improved from FY 2018 to FY2019. When Belinda or Derrick walk through their risk assessment with her, they can interpret the above to let Janice understand.



When we analyze the risk assessment, we will not solely place our judgement base on the color of the risk but also take the big picture of the business into consideration. Treating the risk will be different when we are downsizing or expanding business.



Per Group Finance, the change in the EBIDTA in this scenario is not happening very often in the Group. Hence, in the future, we will figure out what kind of measurement to apply on the business to  best describe the severity of the risk. At this moment, EBIDTA is the one we will apply on all business for the consistence. For Function Units, we will use OPEX.

For a good investment, the company shall have a good position itself\. 
- For CEB Green tech, I can’t see its position, so I sold it a few days ago to cut the loss\.
- For BYD, it is more focused on the car business now\. And battery related product, and also electronic product\. I think it could have a good future\. \- when the price is lower, around $200, I will buy one more

entries.text:
# Hiking to see 吊鐘花
It’s 9:49am\. I’m on minibus 12 to Sai Kung\. I’m listening the story from Kindle\. Audio book\. I have read many books in the past\. But little spent on listening\. It made my reading is better than listening\. I shall improve in listening\.

Today hiking was to see 吊鐘花\. So we went to 大枕蓋\. The beginning path is the same as before we went 2 years ago\. i\.e\. from Lee Tomb to the trail\. However, we found many people already in the bus, and in the sites\. So we made some detour during the hike\. We found a secret area where we can appreciate the flowers quietly\. 

Just that during the process, I accidentally got a grass probe into my eye\. Hope there are no big issue\.

![](dayone-moment://967ECCB0C5034B61B8B9AD4A17794172)

After appreciating the flowers, we made a detour\. We didn’t go to 鯽魚湖, but went to the other side \(east\), and then go north\. We passed an areas with burnt grass, then toward 北潭凹 starting point direction\. We could see 赤徑 from the far\. 


![](dayone-moment://6F37DA06A2B64793B05A4ADD9E13EC8E)

We also saw a number of 吊鐘花 in the trail\. Not very difficult to walk\. 
We left at the camping site of 北潭凹\. Then took 94 bus back to Sai Kung pier\. We had lunch there at 4:30pm\. I ate 黑椒牛柳絲炒意粉\. Other than too much black pepper, it was a nice dish\. 

Tired after the hike\. Slept after dinner\. Going to sleep again now\.

Hope there are no big issue."},{"embeddedObjects":[{"type":"photo","identifier":"967ECCB0C5034B61B8B9AD4A17794172"}]},{"text":"After appreciating the flowers, we made a detour. We didn’t go to 鯽魚湖, but went to the other side (east), and then go north. We passed an areas with burnt grass, then toward 北潭凹 starting point direction. We could see 赤徑 from the far. 
 "},{"embeddedObjects":[{"type":"photo","identifier":"6F37DA06A2B64793B05A4ADD9E13EC8E"}]},{"text":"We also saw a number of 吊鐘花 in the trail. Not very difficult to walk. 
We left at the camping site of 北潭凹. Then took 94 bus back to Sai Kung pier. We had lunch there at 4:30pm. I ate 黑椒牛柳絲炒意粉. Other than too much black pepper, it was a nice dish. 

Tired after the hike. Slept after dinner. Going to sleep again now."}]}

entries.text:
# Pick what I take, treasure my life
I’m lucky\. To have meet so many good people\. To be raised in a good family\. TO have good health as of now\.

Time fly\. So don’t regret\. 

Staying at home today\. Want to do some study and then work\. Also want to decorate the home a bit\. 
- [ ] To paint the wall\. 
	- [ ] 首先，請拔除所有牆上的釘子和螺絲釘，這樣您才可以有一面完整的牆面，油漆時也會更順手。
	- [ ] 使用彈性填縫膠填補小洞和裂縫。
	- [ ] 清潔的牆面真的很重要。請以肥皂 \(或清潔劑\) 清洗牆面，然後以清水再次清洗，去除任何殘留的皂液或清潔劑。
	- [ ] 使用中級或細砂紙輕輕打磨牆面，讓牆面更光滑。
	- [ ] 如果您要油漆的牆面是新牆或是沒髹過，那您就必須要先上一層「底漆」。髹底漆很簡單，只要用一點油漆，和水稀釋然後均於塗抹牆面，之後您就可以開始塗刷油漆了！
- [ ] Replace the sockets
- [X] Replace the mattress
- [ ] Throw away the old table \(any value for reuse?\)

Investment \- I have read a lot about investment\. But still some time hard to make my decision\. The information I got just can’t turn into the decision\. I think I shall be more focused:
- How the business work?
- What make the business great?
- What are the environment factors? Change?

For the whole day, I didn’t do much work\. Ott

# 如何準備牆面進行油漆 | 首頁| 多樂士
https://www\.dulux\.com\.hk/zh/decorating\-tips\-and\-advice/how\-prepare\-your\-walls\-painting

> 想要有完美無瑕的油漆成果嗎？以下是您可以準備牆面進行油漆的方式。
> 首先，請拔除所有牆上的釘子和螺絲釘，這樣您才可以有一面完整的牆面，油漆時也會更順手。
> 
> 使用彈性填縫膠填補小洞和裂縫。
> 
> 清潔的牆面真的很重要。請以肥皂 \(或清潔劑\) 清洗牆面，然後以清水再次清洗，去除任何殘留的皂液或清潔劑。
> 
> 使用中級或細砂紙輕輕打磨牆面，讓牆面更光滑。
> 
> 如果您要油漆的牆面是新牆或是沒髹過，那您就必須要先上一層「底漆」。髹底漆很簡單，只要用一點油漆，和水稀釋然後均於塗抹牆面，之後您就可以開始塗刷油漆了！

# Family lunch for CNY

This is what I think meaningful in life\. Solve problems, create something meaningful\. And as a hero\.

![](dayone-moment://2CF983CB36E64BC3A5A821D0256ACA45)

We ate at our eldest brother place\. For lunch\. My 2nd brother and sister family were also there\.

![](dayone-moment://3D588D4AD65C4A7F9270F12D4CF7AABE)

After that I went to Kwun Tong to repair the iPhone XS screen\. I walked around\. It was the store near escalator the cheapest\. At $500\. So I chose there\.

![](dayone-moment://852EBDD8139F439B8A37C856EF11C75D)

Now it is getting back to normal\. I can start using it at home\. Also as my mother phone\. During my visit, I was asked by my eldest brother whether to meet with a girl at 32 years old working in bank industry\. I rejected it\. Because I already have one\.

I want to introduce her to my family\. But there is problem in age\. And work together in the same company\. 

While many nations are printing money \(e\.g\. US\), why we are not aware of inflation?

![](dayone-moment://8C9D1E8E2F474BAE82FF390F2C898C43)

Lots of money got export \(goods and service\)\. 
- Inflation \-> Tesla stock, \.\.\.bitcoin, realistic bloom
- People buy goods later
- Run out of resource\-> inflation

# CNY eve
Work from Home today\. Only need to work until 3pm\. But I worked a bit longer, as lots to clear\.

MOOV x Club 激安百貨

![](dayone-moment://4FC9F384430E4C3CAFC7C5E43BC6A30A)

![](dayone-moment://BB135A5290A94124B72B20856C9981CA)

Aplikazone \- divest and hide the transactions\.

After the work, I went to 2nd brother home to have dinner\. We took bus\. Wait for 20 min\.\.\. Should have been taking taxi\. It took too long\.

We arrived around 6:40pm\. Then had dinner\. When I tried to open the bottle of alcohol, I scratch my left thumb\. Got hurt quite often recently\.\.\. should be more careful\.

After the dinner, my brother made a call to 榮貞，榮棟。It has been a while\. Also saw 榮棟’s son and his grandchild\.

After the call, we took a cab to left around 10pm\.

It’s 12:58\. Sleep now\.

"},{"text":"Taking taxi now to the waiting point. I think it would cost around $200. But want to save time. We would take a new route today. 

UM5609 is the car no. its final cost is $180.

# Hiking in Tai Po
Taking taxi now to the waiting point\. I think it would cost around $200\. But want to save time\. We would take a new route today\. 

UM5609 is the car no\. its final cost is $180\.

The weather turned out to be nice today\. I was worried that it would be cloudy\.

We went to Hung Shek Mun and Ma Tao Fung\. I took my Lumix camera with me\. But I use “raw” file format\. It took a lots of space, so only could take a few photos\. It is better to use it to do zooming\.

Below are on the way to Hung Shek Mun\. We turned left when we reached the dangerous sign, after 觀音峒\. Then view when going down were beautiful\. Sky and ocean were blue\. The ocean can reflect the image of the sky\.

![](dayone-moment://5DEF747DEF794E4899CBBBD94C180759)

When we went down for around 15\-20 min\. We reached a 配水庫\. Took some photos as, the water were clear\.

![](dayone-moment://08FCDE9E23B44594A7C49F42DB2167BD)

Afterward, we passed a small lake\. It is good to take some photos there\.\.

![](dayone-moment://75B911F7CAB14302BB2E2EC4B0FDFA1C)

![](dayone-moment://8E49F4E7865A464F91B6374B82E45C22)

![](dayone-moment://C6AD7378EFD043699B86A14A146E11E0)

Not long after that we arrived the ocean, and saw many red rock\. The scent of ocean were strong\. It was beautiful\. We took some photos around the dam\.

![](dayone-moment://11133B56AEB34457A1ED41312A417903)

Then go further to find good places for photos\.

![](dayone-moment://610DA89D6BB445788AFBCE703F75C11B)

![](dayone-moment://AD4E51A2FFEC49ADBD0CC1924CADCFC9)

After that, we found a place with good view to have bread\. We saw many fishes and carol in that areas\. And also jelly fish\! It was the first time I saw a real one\.

After some rest, we walked around and then returned\. 

We decided to take Ma Tao Fung returned to Wu Gao Tang\. Because we never went that way\. The view was beautiful, as we can saw the reservoir along the way\. It was around 3\-4pm\.

![](dayone-moment://19A996D0C1744D689A06BDD9709C666B)

It was ups and downs\. But that was fine to me\. It was said to have 7 times\. We reached 2 標高柱\.

![](dayone-moment://3A6E78877BB443D3AC21DC0F30D694D2)

![](dayone-moment://90A4E7C20974407CA167E58CC733A1DC)

![](dayone-moment://55D9AD3D939042ADAE4403D46D1BC3F3)

After the hike, we took 725R return to tai po market station\.
I bought some grape at $120\. Then we ate ice cream, and returned home separately\.

Rule 4 : Only listen to those you know and trust

在7月、8月推出涉款逾1000萬元的「齊齊打疫苗，日日有抽獎」獎勵計劃，包括iPhone12一部連旗下數碼通 （00315） SmarTone 5G計劃，員工、香港市民各一部。新地表示，每日送出92份獎品，得獎幸運兒將超過5,700 人，大抽獎的獎品由新地和郭氏家族一同出資。抽獎獎品尚包括酒店餐飲現金券、一田超市禮券、Staycation宅度假住宿套票及The Point 積分，詳情會另作公布。

entries.text:
iPad mini 20211104
Today is the first time I experience with iPad mini\. I purchased it in Telford\. With apple care\. 256gb\. Because I would use it more often than the other iPad and even iPhone\.

The typing experience is not bad\. I think it is better than using normal size iPad\. It’s great to type in split view\. Not need to stretching my thumbs far away from the other side\. The horizontal view typing experience is even better than vertical\. The iPad Pro is too heavy\. I just cannot bring it around conveniently\.

I would take it with me more often so that I can use it for my learning\. And working\.

When I know that time is limited\. I shall be more focused\. To deliver the things that I can to achieve more\.  I have tested a lots on different things\. I think it’s good for my exam study\. Don’t need another keyboard\. If it is in split view, it seems to be the best for typing\.

entries.text:
Price Fixing

Price fixing is when competitors agree on pricing rather than competing against each other\. This includes agreeing to prices, a formula to calculate prices / margin or elements of a price such as discounts, rebates, promotions or credit terms\.

Price fixing can occur verbally or in writing – agreement can be by a 'wink and a nod', made over a drink, price fixing can occur at an association meeting or at a social occasion\.

In a competitive market, each competitor should make price decisions independently\. Anything that removes price uncertainty between competitors risks being a form of price fixing which hurts consumers and other businesses\.

Price fixing increases prices and reduce quality of the products sold\. Under the Competition Ordinance, it is a serious anti\-competitive conduct\.

Reseller?

#regulation
#work

# Overview

## What is Competition?
In a free market economy, businesses compete with each other to offer the best range of products at the best price\. A competitive market leads to better prices, products and choice for everyone\.

Competition also drives efficiency and innovation, and directs businesses to meet consumer demands by providing the right products at the right price and quality\.

## Understanding the Competition Ordinance
Click \[here\] for easy\-to\-follow brochures to help you understand the Competition Ordinance\.

The Competition Ordinance is designed to promote competition and prohibit anti\-competitive practices\.

The introduction of a cross\-sector competition regime to Hong Kong is an important step in safeguarding our shared value of fair competition\. The Competition Ordinance \(Ordinance\) ensures this by making certain business practices which undermine competition illegal\.

The Ordinance prohibits three types of anti\-competitive conduct described under the First Conduct Rule, the Second Conduct Rule and the Merger Rule which are collectively known as the "competition rules"\.

The Competition Commission \(Commission\) has produced a number of videos and infographics which describe simply different types of anti\-competitive conduct\.

For further information, please refer to the Guideline on the First Conduct Rule\. You can also read “The Competition Ordinance and SMEs" brochure to learn more about different type of anti\-competitive conduct in an easy\-to\-understand approach\.

The First Conduct Rule

The First Conduct Rule seeks to prohibit arrangements between market participants \(whether they are competitors or not\) which prevent, restrict or distort competition in Hong Kong\. For example, it prevents competitors colluding on key parameters of competition such as price, output or how they bid to harm competition in Hong Kong\.

These propositions are embodied in the First Conduct Rule set out in section 6\(1\) of the Ordinance:

“An undertaking must not \(a\) make or give effect to an agreement; \(b\) engage in a concerted practice; or \(c\) as a member of an association of undertakings, make or give effect to a decision of the association, if the object or effect of the agreement, concerted practice or decision is to prevent, restrict or distort competition in Hong Kong\.”

Examples of conduct which may contravene the First Conduct Rule include:

Cartels \(i\.e\. agreeing with your competitors to fix prices, share markets, rig bids or restrict output\)
Exchange of information
Activities of trade associations and industry bodies
Joint Ventures
Vertical price restrictions
Exclusive distribution and exclusive customer allocation
The Second Conduct Rule

Under the Ordinance, businesses with a substantial degree of market power are also prohibited from abusing that power to harm competition\.

The Second Conduct Rule targets businesses with a substantial degree of market power in abusing that power with a view to protecting or increasing their position of power and profits\. Competition law is not concerned with the mere possession of substantial degree of market power\. It is only when there is an abuse of such power that raises concerns\. Certain conduct \(see the examples provided below\) engaged in by businesses with substantial market power can have the object or effect of excluding competitors from the market, thereby limiting choices available to consumers\. This principle is embodied in section 21 of the Ordinance, or the Second Conduct Rule:

\(1\) An undertaking that has a substantial degree of market power in a market must not abuse that power by engaging in conduct that has as its object or effect the prevention, restriction or distortion of competition in Hong Kong\.

\(2\) For the purpose of subsection \(1\), conduct may, in particular, constitute such an abuse if it involves—

\(a\) predatory behaviour towards competitors; or
\(b\) limiting production, markets or technical development to the prejudice of consumers\.

Only a limited number of large businesses are likely to have substantial market power\. Small and medium\-sized undertakings may be victims of abusive conduct under the Second Conduct Rule\.

Examples of conduct which may contravene the Second Conduct Rule include:

Predatory pricing
Anti\-competitive tying and bundling
Margin squeeze
Refusals to deal
Exclusive dealing
The Merger Rule

Mergers that have or are likely to have the effect of substantially lessening competition in Hong Kong are prohibited under the Ordinance\. The scope of application of the Merger Rule is currently limited to mergers relating to undertakings directly or indirectly holding carrier licences issued under the Telecommunications Ordinance \(Cap\. 106\)\.

How do I comply?

The Commission has released easy to follow brochures, a toolkit and videos for trade associations and small and medium enterprises to help them understand the Ordinance\. You may also refer to this website and the Commission’s Guidelines\.

How do I complain?

Details on how to contact the Commission to make a complaint are here\.

go to 大嶺峒 20220312
After a long rest due to COVID, finally I went for hiking with Kammy to Clear Water Bay Area\. Haven’t been to there for a long while\. The weather was good\. We started around 10am\. We walked from Hang Hou, through High Junk Hill, then passed the turnaround\. Walked along the road beside the sea\.

We saw a wide sea, it was beautiful\. We had lunch there\. It was comfortable sitting there\. There is a 古蹟\. And 4\-5 people fishing\. On the sea, some people were playing boat\.

After a short break, we started our journey\. It was already very close, only take around 5 more minutes, we arrived the entrance to the trail\.

到M3\-4 行山 20220319
昨天去了行M3\-4, 從花心坑離開。從早上9:00am由家出發走到井欄樹，再乘小巴1A到西貢巴士總站，轉乘94號巴士。在巴士上跟Kammy 會合。她買了一個大五谷麵包$37。
整天行山沿途都有霧。因為我們最近都很少行山，所以到了雞公山山頂她已經沒有太多體力了。而且在後來的行程，下山時ITBand 都有些緊，而她左邊更是很痛，要走得慢些。下次可以試吓用行山杖，減少下山時的壓力。
完成後，大概5:10pm\. 我們去了廣源邨一葉小廚吃飯，各自叫了一份豬排飯，十分滿足。
後來，我跑到巴士站乘82X，到新蒲崗四美街，轉乘290回家。

雖然整天都有霧，但在這春暖花開的日子，我們看到不少盛開的花。紫色的杜鵑花在馬鞍山山脊，小小的石斑木在第三段中途，沿着路邊生長的紫色的韓信草，還有些少吊鐘花開著在雞公山上山段。

![](dayone-moment://7B5862185A3E4E859D2B601DD145C09D)

下星期，天氣可能，不太好。有什麼好去處呢？

何謂無水晶球？

- 在未有空少事件前，國泰客機去貨返，己經有多方提醒是個漏洞，你有聽嗎？但你當時話影響到香港貨運，誰負責？
- 後來在疫情初期，不少人都提議做全民強檢，堵截傳播鍊，你又話係人哋的方法唔適合香港
- 安心出行無追蹤功能，一但爆疫極難追蹤，沒有人講嗎？

## Here is Veronica's elaboration on the distribution agent vs Competition Guidelines:
" The concept of an agency arrangement, in this case a distribution agent, is basically the same under competition law as in any other context\. The Guidelines issued by the Competition Commission \("Guidelines"\) set out some guidance on what the Competition Commission considers to be a "true distribution agent"\. In the case of services, " a distributor acts as a true distribution agent of the supplier if it does not bear any, or only bears insignificant, risks in relation to the contracts concluded on behalf of the supplier\. This might be the case where the distribution agent \[in this case SUN\] does not itself supply the contract services and where the distribution agent does not bear any, or bears only an insignificant portion, of\.\.\.risks and costs\." The Guidelines include a non\-exhaustive list of risks and costs which is generally more relevant to goods rather than services but which notably includes costs or risks associated with non\-performance by the customer \(e\.g\. late or non\-payment by the customer\)\. Where a distributor is acting as a  "true distribution agent" the provisions of the Competition Ordinance regarding anti\-competitive agreements will not apply to restrictions imposed in the distribution agreement in so far as they relate to contracts concluded on behalf of the supplier\. This includes restrictions imposed on the distributor which limits the prices and conditions at which the distributor can sell the contract products/services\.

"Suggested Retail Price" is always acceptable as long as this is true and that the downstream seller does actually have the discretion to change the retail price should they wish to\. "

Hope this helps and let me know if you want to have further discussion with Veronica on Competition related issues\.

#regulation
#work

entries.text:
# Hiking at Sai Kung North
Started from M3 through 嶂上, 石屋山 \(which has very nice view of South China Sea, Sai Kung \!\)\. Then to 蛇石\. In the path, we did many climbing\. But it was worthwhile\.

![](dayone-moment://538DD6C9AF72400AAC010DC046A9EBD1)

![](dayone-moment://AA559D7B954045B095172EA54A33F1CC)

After that we turn right and go to 荔枝莊\. At the seashore, we saw some special rocks there\. It started raining again\. To be safe, we didn’t go to the path to 蛇石 thru 雞麻峒。

![](dayone-moment://C231DCD08F8E4251BA98DB33CCA2E76D)

![](dayone-moment://7EA187A58FFD4A549FC21B5914A7262B)

So we return to 蛇石through the main road\. It wasn’t long\. Took around 1\.5 hours\. Then we walk along the path to 深涌，to 榕樹澳，then to 水浪窩\. Found that my mobile still didn’t work… We took 99 bus to Ma On Shan, then have McDonald as dinner and then I took 89D bus to Kwun Tong and 98A to home\.

It was cold at night\. I took a hot bath\. Felt much better\.

#hiking

Happy birthday to Kammy
Just had a short day of working\. Then I went to MOS to celebrate birthday with Kammy\. She bought a cake in the wet market at $80\. We pick it at Yiu On Estate\. Then walked to a part near the sea side in Wu Kai Sa\. Start eating the cake around 6pm\.

After returning home, I took some time to explore why it got so many space used up by system data\. It was found from Tencent app that is is mainly caused by Outlook app\. So I immediate the data in Group container\. And also delete outlook app\.

We will go hiking tomorrow\. So would sleep now\.

entries.text:
Data filter

\[[https://www\.odata\.org/documentation/odata\-version\-2\-0/uri\-conventions/](https://www.odata.org/documentation/odata-version-2-0/uri-conventions/%5D)[\]](https://www.odata.org/documentation/odata-version-2-0/uri-conventions/%5D)

OData Version 4\.0 is the current recommended version of OData\. OData V4 has been standardized by OASIS and has many features not included in OData Version 2\.0\.

Go to OData Version 4\.0
Introduction
The Open Data Protocol \(OData\) enables the creation of REST\-based data services, which allow resources, identified using Uniform Resource Identifiers \(URIs\) and defined in a data model, to be published and edited by Web clients using simple HTTP messages\. This specification defines a set of recommended \(but not required\) rules for constructing URIs to identify the data and metadata exposed by an OData server as well as a set of reserved URI query string operators, which if accepted by an OData server, MUST be implemented as required by this document\.

The \[OData:Atom\] and \[OData:JSON\] documents specify the format of the resource representations that are exchanged using OData and the \[OData:Operations\] document describes the actions that can be performed on the URIs \(optionally constructed following the conventions defined in this document\) embedded in those representations\.

It is encouraged that servers follow the URI construction conventions defined in this specification when possible as such consistency promotes an ecosystem of reusable client components and libraries\.

The terms used in this document are defined in the \[OData:Terms\] document\.

1. URI Components A URI used by an OData service has up to three significant parts: the service root URI, resource path and query string options\. Additional URI constructs \(such as a fragment\) MAY be present in a URI used by an OData service; however, this specification applies no further meaning to such additional constructs\.

ODataUri

The following are two example URIs broken down into their component parts:

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_/
| service root URI
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Category\(1\)/Products?$top=2&$orderby=name
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_/ \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_/  \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_/
|                                |                    |
service root URI                  resource path        query options

2. Service Root URI The service root URI identifies the root of an OData service\. The resource identified by this URI MUST be an AtomPub Service Document \(as specified in \[RFC5023\]\) and follow the OData conventions for AtomPub Service Documents \(or an alternate representation of an Atom Service Document if a different format is requested\)\. OData: JSON Format specifies such an alternate JSON\-based representation of a service document\. The service document is required to be returned from the root of an OData service to provide clients with a simple mechanism to enumerate all of the collections of resources available for the data service\.

Example Request URI OData Service URI
https://services\.odata\.org:8080 https://services\.odata\.org:8080
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories   https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/

3. Resource Path The resource path construction rules defined in this section are optional\. OData servers are encouraged to follow the URI path construction rules \(in addition to the required query string rules\) as such consistency promotes a rich ecosystem of reusable client components and libraries\.

The resource path section of a URI identifies the resource to be interacted with \(such as Customers, a single Customer, Orders related to Customers in London, and so forth\)\. The resource path enables any aspect of the data model \(Collections of Entries, a single Entry, Properties, Links, Service Operations, and so on\) exposed by an OData service to be addressed\.

3\.1\. Addressing Entries
The basic rules for addressing a Collection \(of Entries\), a single Entry within a Collection, as well as a property of an Entry are illustrated in the figure below\.

ResourcePath

Collection: The name of a Collection or Service Operation \(which returns a Collection of Entries\) exposed by the service\.
KeyPredicate: A predicate that identifies the value\(s\) of the key Properties of an Entry\. If the Entry has a single key Property the predicate may include only the value of the key Property\. If the key is made up of two or more Properties, then its value must be stated using name/value pairs\. More precisely, the syntax for a KeyPredicate is shown by the following figure\.
keyPredicate

NavPropSingle: The name of a Navigation Property defined by the Entry associated with the prior path segment\. The Navigation Property must identify a single entity \(that is, have a "to 1" relationship\)\.
NavPropCollection: Same as NavPropSingle except it must identify a Collection of Entries \(that is, have a "to many" relationship\)\.
ComplexType: The name of a declared or dynamic Property of the Entry or Complex Type associated with the prior path segment\.
Property: The name of a declared or dynamic Property of the Entry or Complex Type associated with the prior path segment\.
For OData services conformant with the addressing conventions in this section, the canonical form of an absolute URI identifying a single Entry is formed by adding a single path segment to the service root URI\. The path segment is made up of the name of the Collection associated with the Entry followed by the key predicate identifying the Entry within the Collection\. For example the URIs https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories\(1\)/Products\(1\) and https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products\(1\) represent the same Entry, but the canonical URI for the Entry is https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products\(1\)\.

Examples

The example URIs below follow the addressing rules stated above and are based on the reference service and its service metadata document available at https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/ and https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/$metadata\.

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories

Identifies all Categories Collection\.
Is described by the Entity Set named "Categories" in the service metadata document\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories\(1\)

Identifies a single Category Entry with key value 1\.
Is described by the Entity Type named "Categories" in the service metadata document\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories\(1\)/Name

Identifies the Name property of the Categories Entry with key value 1\.
Is described by the Property named "Name" on the "Categories" Entity Type in the service metadata document\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories\(1\)/Products

Identifies the collection of Products associated with Category Entry with key value 1\.
Is described by the Navigation Property named "Products" on the "Category" Entity Type in the service metadata document\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories\(1\)/Products/$count

Identifies the number of Product Entries associated with Category 1\.
Is described by the Navigation Property named "Products" on the "Category" Entity Type in the service metadata document\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories\(1\)/Products\(1\)/Supplier/Address/City

Identifies the City of the Supplier for Product 1 which is associated with Category 1\.
Is described by the Property named "City" on the "Address" Complex Type in the service metadata document\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories\(1\)/Products\(1\)/Supplier/Address/City/$value

Same as the URI above, but identifies the "raw value" of the City property\.
3\.2\. Addressing Links between Entries
Much like the use of links on Web pages, the data model used by OData services supports relationships as a first class construct\. For example, an OData service could expose a Collection of Products Entries each of which are related to a Category Entry\.

Associations between Entries are addressable in OData just like Entries themselves are \(as described above\)\. The basic rules for addressing relationships are shown in the following figure\.

addressingRelationships

NavigationProperty: The name of a Navigation Property that is declared on the Entry associated with the path segment prior to the "$links" segment\.
Examples

The example URIs below follow the addressing rules stated above and are based on the reference service and its service metadata document available at https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/ and https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/$metadata\.

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories\(1\)/$links/Products

Identifies the set of Products related to Category 1\.
Is described by the Navigation Property named "Products" on the "Category" Entity Type in the associated service metadata document\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products\(1\)/$links/Category

Identifies the Category related to Product 1\.
Is described by the Navigation Property named "Category" on the "Product" Entity Type in the associated service metadata document\.
3\.3\. Addressing Service Operations
OData services can expose Service Operations which, like Entries, are identified using a URI\. Service Operations are simple functions exposed by an OData service whose semantics are defined by the author of the function\. A Service Operation can accept primitive type input parameters and can be defined to return a single primitive, single complex type, collection of primitives, collection of complex types, a single Entry, a Collection of Entries, or void\. The basic rules for constructing URIs to address Service Operations and to pass parameters to them are illustrated in the following figure\.

addressingServiceOperations

ServiceRootUri: The service root URI identifies the root of the OData service\.
ServiceOperation: The name of a Service Operation exposed by an OData service\.
ParamName: The name of a parameter accepted by the Service Operation\. If the Service Operation accepts multiple parameters, the order of the parameters in the query string of the URI is insignificant\.
ParamValue: The value of the parameter\. The format of the value is defined by the literal form column of the table in the Abstract Types section of \[OData:Core\] \(the OData overview specification\) \.
Examples

The example URIs below follow the addressing rules stated above and are based on the reference service and its service metadata document available at https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/ and https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/$metadata\.

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/ProductsByColor?color='red'

Identifies the ProductByColor Service Operation and passes it a single string parameter\. Since Service Operations are just functions, their semantics are up to the implementer of the function\. In this case the Service Operation returns all the red Products\.
Is described by the Function Import named "ProductsByColor" that accepts a single string parameter named "color" in the service metadata document\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/ProductsByColor\(3\)/Category/Name?color='red'

Identifies the same function as the example above; however, since the function returns a collection of Entries \(here, Products\) it acts as a pseudo Collection in that additional path segments may follow identifying Entries or Links from the Entries within the pseudo Collection identified by the Service Operation\. In this case, the result of the function is treated as a Collection of Entries, as described by the prior Addressing Entries section\.
Is described in the service metadata document by:
The Function Import named "ProductsByColor" that accepts a single string parameter named "color"\.
The "Category" Navigation Property on the "Product" Entity Type\.
The "Name" property on the "Category" Entity Type\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/ProductsByColor?color='red'&param=foo

Same as the example below, except an additional parameter \(param\) is specified\. Since the function does not define an input parameter named param, this parameter is ignored and not considered part of the function invocation\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/ProductColors

Identifies the ProductColors Service Operation that accepts no parameters\.
Is described by the Function Import named "ProductColors" in the service metadata document\. This function returns a collection of strings\.

4. Query String Options The Query Options section of an OData URI specifies three types of information: System Query Options, Custom Query Options, and Service Operation Parameters\. All OData services must follow the query string parsing and construction rules defined in this section and its subsections\.

4\.1\. System Query Options
System Query Options are query string parameters a client may specify to control the amount and order of the data that an OData service returns for the resource identified by the URI\. The names of all System Query Options are prefixed with a "$" character\.

An OData service may support some or all of the System Query Options defined\. If a data service does not support a System Query Option, it must reject any requests which contain the unsupported option as defined by the request processing rules in \[OData:Operations\]\.

4\.2\. Orderby System Query Option \($orderby\)
A data service URI with a $orderby System Query Option specifies an expression for determining what values are used to order the collection of Entries identified by the Resource Path section of the URI\. This query option is only supported when the resource path identifies a Collection of Entries\.

The $orderby section of the normative OData specification outlines the full expression syntax supported by this query option\. The examples below represent the most commonly supported subset of that expression syntax\.

Examples

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$orderby=Rating

All Product Entries returned in ascending order when sorted by the Rating Property\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$orderby=Rating asc

Same as the example above\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$orderby=Rating,Category/Name desc

Same as the URI above except the set of Products is subsequently sorted \(in descending order\) by the Name property of the related Category Entry\.
4\.3\. Top System Query Option \($top\)
A data service URI with a $top System Query Option identifies a subset of the Entries in the Collection of Entries identified by the Resource Path section of the URI\. This subset is formed by selecting only the first N items of the set, where N is an integer greater than or equal to zero specified by this query option\. If a value less than zero is specified, the URI should be considered malformed\.

If the data service URI contains a $top query option, but does not contain a $orderby option, then the Entries in the set needs to first be fully ordered by the data service\. While no ordering semantics are mandated, to ensure repeatable results, a data service must always use the same semantics to obtain a full ordering across requests\.

Examples

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$top=5

The first 5 Product Entries returned where the Collection of Products are sorted using a scheme determined by the OData service\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$top=5&$orderby=Name desc

The first 5 Product Entries returned in descending order when sorted by the Name property\.
4\.4\. Skip System Query Option \($skip\)
A data service URI with a $skip System Query Option identifies a subset of the Entries in the Collection of Entries identified by the Resource Path section of the URI\. That subset is defined by seeking N Entries into the Collection and selecting only the remaining Entries \(starting with Entry N\+1\)\. N is an integer greater than or equal to zero specified by this query option\. If a value less than zero is specified, the URI should be considered malformed\.

If the data service URI contains a $skip query option, but does not contain a $orderby option, then the Entries in the Collection must first be fully ordered by the data service\. While no ordering semantics are mandated, to ensure repeatable results a data service must always use the same semantics to obtain a full ordering across requests\.

Examples

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories\(1\)/Products?$skip=2

The set of Product Entries \(associated with the Category Entry identified by key value 1\) starting with the third product\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$skip=2&$top=2&$orderby=Rating

The third and fourth Product Entry from the collection of all products when the collection is sorted by Rating \(ascending\)\.
4\.5\. Filter System Query Option \($filter\)
A URI with a $filter System Query Option identifies a subset of the Entries from the Collection of Entries identified by the Resource Path section of the URI\. The subset is determined by selecting only the Entries that satisfy the predicate expression specified by the query option\.

The expression language that is used in $filter operators supports references to properties and literals\. The literal values can be strings enclosed in single quotes, numbers and boolean values \(true or false\) or any of the additional literal representations shown in the Abstract Type System section\.

Note: The $filter section of the normative OData specification provides an ABNF grammar for the expression language supported by this query option\.

The operators supported in the expression language are shown in the following table\.

Operator    Description Example
Logical Operators
Eq  Equal   /Suppliers?$filter=Address/City eq 'Redmond'
Ne  Not equal   /Suppliers?$filter=Address/City ne 'London'
Gt  Greater than    /Products?$filter=Price gt 20
Ge  Greater than or equal   /Products?$filter=Price ge 10
Lt  Less than   /Products?$filter=Price lt 20
Le  Less than or equal  /Products?$filter=Price le 100
And Logical and /Products?$filter=Price le 200 and Price gt 3\.5
Or  Logical or  /Products?$filter=Price le 3\.5 or Price gt 200
Not Logical negation    /Products?$filter=not endswith\(Description,'milk'\)
Arithmetic Operators
Add Addition    /Products?$filter=Price add 5 gt 10
Sub Subtraction /Products?$filter=Price sub 5 gt 10
Mul Multiplication  /Products?$filter=Price mul 2 gt 2000
Div Division    /Products?$filter=Price div 2 gt 4
Mod Modulo  /Products?$filter=Price mod 2 eq 0
Grouping Operators
\( \) Precedence grouping /Products?$filter=\(Price sub 5\) gt 10
In addition to operators, a set of functions are also defined for use with the filter query string operator\. The following table lists the available functions\. Note: ISNULL or COALESCE operators are not defined\. Instead, there is a null literal which can be used in comparisons\.

Function    Example
String Functions
bool substringof\(string po, string p1\)  https://services\.odata\.org/Northwind/Northwind\.svc/Customers?$filter=substringof\('Alfreds', CompanyName\) eq true
bool endswith\(string p0, string p1\) https://services\.odata\.org/Northwind/Northwind\.svc/Customers?$filter=endswith\(CompanyName, 'Futterkiste'\) eq true

string substring\(string p0, int pos\)    https://services\.odata\.org/Northwind/Northwind\.svc/Customers?$filter=substring\(CompanyName, 1\) eq 'lfreds Futterkiste'
string substring\(string p0, int pos, int length\)    https://services\.odata\.org/Northwind/Northwind\.svc/Customers?$filter=substring\(CompanyName, 1, 2\) eq 'lf'

string concat\(string p0, string p1\) https://services\.odata\.org/Northwind/Northwind\.svc/Customers?$filter=concat\(concat\(City, ', '\), Country\) eq 'Berlin, Germany'
Date Functions
int day\(DateTime p0\)    https://services\.odata\.org/Northwind/Northwind\.svc/Employees?$filter=day\(BirthDate\) eq 8
int hour\(DateTime p0\)   https://services\.odata\.org/Northwind/Northwind\.svc/Employees?$filter=hour\(BirthDate\) eq 0

Math Functions
