decimal ceiling\(decimal p0\) https://services\.odata\.org/Northwind/Northwind\.svc/Orders?$filter=floor\(Freight\) eq 33
Type Functions
bool IsOf\(type p0\)  https://services\.odata\.org/Northwind/Northwind\.svc/Orders?$filter=isof\('NorthwindModel\.Order'\)
bool IsOf\(expression p0, type p1\)   https://services\.odata\.org/Northwind/Northwind\.svc/Orders?$filter=isof\(ShipCountry, 'Edm\.String'\)
4\.6\. Expand System Query Option \($expand\)
A URI with a $expand System Query Option indicates that Entries associated with the Entry or Collection of Entries identified by the Resource Path section of the URI must be represented inline \(i\.e\. eagerly loaded\)\. For example, if you want to identify a category and its products, you could use two URIs \(and execute two requests\), one for /Categories\(1\) and one for /Categories\(1\)/Products\. The '$expand' option allows you to identify related Entries with a single URI such that a graph of Entries could be retrieved with a single HTTP request\.

The syntax of a $expand query option is a comma\-separated list of Navigation Properties\. Additionally each Navigation Property can be followed by a forward slash and another Navigation Property to enable identifying a multi\-level relationship\.

Note: The $filter section of the normative OData specification provides an ABNF grammar for the expression language supported by this query option\.

Examples

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories?$expand=Products

Identifies the Collection of Categories as well as each of the Products associated with each Category\.
Is described by the Entity Set named "Categories" and the "Products" Navigation Property on the "Category" Entity Type in the service metadata document\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories?$expand=Products/Suppliers

Identifies the Collection of Categories as well as each of the Products associated with each Category\. In addition, the URI also indentifies the Suppliers associated with each Product\.
Is described by the Entity Set named "Categories", the "Products" Navigation Property on the "Category" Entity Type, and the "Suppliers" Navigation Property on the "Product" Entity Type in the service metadata document\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$expand=Category,Suppliers

Identifies the set of Products as well as the category and suppliers associated with each product\.
Is described by the Entity Set named "Products" as well as the "Category" and "Suppliers" Navigation Property on the "Product" Entity Type in the service metadata document\.
4\.7\. Format System Query Option \($format\)
A URI with a $format System Query Option specifies that a response to the request MUST use the media type specified by the query option\. If the $format query option is present in a request URI it takes precedence over the value\(s\) specified in the Accept request header\. Valid values for the $format query string option are listed in the following table\.

$format Value   Response Media Type
Atom    application/atom\+xml
Xml application/xml
Json    application/json
Any other IANA\-defined content type Any IANA\-defined content type
A service\-specific value indicating a format specific to the specific OData service Any IANA\-defined content type
Examples

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$format=atom

Identifies all Product Entries represented using the AtomPub format as defined in \[OData:Atom\]
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$format=json

Identifies all Product Entries represented using the JSON format as defined in \[OData:JSON\]
4\.8\. Select System Query Option \($select\)
A data service URI with a $select System Query Option identifies the same set of Entries as a URI without a $select query option; however, the value of $select specifies that a response from an OData service should return a subset of the Properties which would have been returned had the URI not included a $select query option\.

Version Note: This query option is only supported in OData version 2\.0 and above\.

The value of a $select System Query Option is a comma\-separated list of selection clauses\. Each selection clause may be a Property name, Navigation Property name, or the "\*" character\. The following set of examples uses the data sample data model available at https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/$metadata to describe the semantics for a base set of URIs using the $select system query option\. From these base cases, the semantics of longer URIs are defined by composing the rules below\.

Examples

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$select=Price,Name

In a response from an OData service, only the Price and Name Property values are returned for each Product Entry within the Collection of products identified\.
If the $select query option had listed a Property that identified a Complex Type, then all Properties defined on the Complex Type must be returned\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$select=Name,Category

In a response from an OData service only the Name Property value and a link to the related Category Entry should be returned for each product\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories?$select=Name,Products&$expand=Products/Suppliers

In a response from an OData service, only the Name of the Category Entries should be returned, but all the properties of the Entries identified by the Products and Suppliers Navigation Properties should be returned\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$select=\*

In a response from an OData service, all Properties are returned for each Product Entry within the Products Entity Set\.
Note: The star syntax is used to reference all properties of the Entry or Collection of Entries identified by the path of the URI or all properties of a Navigation Property\. In other words, the "\*" syntax causes all Properties on an Entry to be included without traversing associations\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Categories?$select=Name,Products&$expand=Products

In a response from an OData service, the Name property is included and Product Entries with all Properties are included; however, rather than including the fully expanded Supplier Entries referenced in the expand clause, each Product will contain a link that references the corresponding Collection of Supplier Entries\.
Note: The $select section of the normative OData specification provides an ABNF grammar for the expression language supported by this query option\.

4\.9\. Inlinecount System Query Option \($inlinecount\)
A URI with a $inlinecount System Query Option specifies that the response to the request includes a count of the number of Entries in the Collection of Entries identified by the Resource Path section of the URI\. The count must be calculated after applying any $filter System Query Options present in the URI\. The set of valid values for the $inlinecount query option are shown in the table below\. If a value other than one shown in Table 4 is specified the URI is considered malformed\.

Version Note: This query option is only supported in OData version 2\.0 and above

$inlinecount value  Description
allpages    The OData MUST include a count of the number of entities in the collection identified by the URI \(after applying any $filter System Query Options present on the URI\)
none    The OData service MUST NOT include a count in the response\. This is equivalence to a URI that does not include a $inlinecount query string parameter\.
Examples

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$inlinecount=allpages

Identifies all Product Entries and the count of all products\.
https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?$inlinecount=allpages&$top=10&$filter=Price gt 200

Identifies the first 10 Product Entries that cost more than 200 and includes a count of the total number of Product Entries that cost more than 200\.

5. Custom Query Options Custom Query Options provide an extension point for OData service\-specific information to be placed in the query string portion of a URI\. A Custom Query String option is defined as any name/value pair query string parameter where the name of the parameter does not begin with the "$" character\. Any URI exposed by an OData service may include one or more Custom Query Options\.

Examples

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/Products?x=y

Identifies all Product entities\. Includes a Custom Query Option "x" whose meaning is service specific\.

6. Service Operation Parameters Service Operations represent functions exposed by an OData service\. These functions may accept zero or more primitive type parameters\. If a Service Operation requires an input parameter those parameters are passed via query string name/value pairs appended to the URI which identify the Service Operation as described in the Addressing Service Operations section\. For nullable type parameters, a null value may be specified by not including the parameter in the query string of the URI\.

Examples

https://services\.odata\.org/OData/OData\.svc/GetProductsByRating?rating=5

Identifies the "GetProductsByRating" Service Operation and specifies a value of 5 for the "rating" input parameter\.

7. URI Equivalence When determining if two URIs are equivalent, each URI SHOULD be normalized using the rules specified in \[RFC3987\] and \[RFC3986\] and then compared for equality using the equivalence rules specified in HTTP \[RFC 2616\], Section 3\.2\.3\.

OData Version 4.0 is the current recommended version of OData. OData V4 has been standardized by OASIS and has many features not included in OData Version 2.0.

Go to OData Version 4.0
Introduction
The Open Data Protocol (OData) enables the creation of REST-based data services, which allow resources, identified using Uniform Resource Identifiers (URIs) and defined in a data model, to be published and edited by Web clients using simple HTTP messages. This specification defines a set of recommended (but not required) rules for constructing URIs to identify the data and metadata exposed by an OData server as well as a set of reserved URI query string operators, which if accepted by an OData server, MUST be implemented as required by this document.

The [OData:Atom] and [OData:JSON] documents specify the format of the resource representations that are exchanged using OData and the [OData:Operations] document describes the actions that can be performed on the URIs (optionally constructed following the conventions defined in this document) embedded in those representations.

It is encouraged that servers follow the URI construction conventions defined in this specification when possible as such consistency promotes an ecosystem of reusable client components and libraries.

The terms used in this document are defined in the [OData:Terms] document.

Additional URI constructs (such as a fragment) MAY be present in a URI used by an OData service; however, this specification applies no further meaning to such additional constructs.

The resource identified by this URI MUST be an AtomPub Service Document (as specified in [RFC5023]) and follow the OData conventions for AtomPub Service Documents (or an alternate representation of an Atom Service Document if a different format is requested). OData: JSON Format specifies such an alternate JSON-based representation of a service document. The service document is required to be returned from the root of an OData service to provide clients with a simple mechanism to enumerate all of the collections of resources available for the data service.

OData servers are encouraged to follow the URI path construction rules (in addition to the required query string rules) as such consistency promotes a rich ecosystem of reusable client components and libraries.
"},{"text":"
The resource path section of a URI identifies the resource to be interacted with (such as Customers, a single Customer, Orders related to Customers in London, and so forth). The resource path enables any aspect of the data model (Collections of Entries, a single Entry, Properties, Links, Service Operations, and so on) exposed by an OData service to be addressed.

3.1. Addressing Entries
The basic rules for addressing a Collection (of Entries), a single Entry within a Collection, as well as a property of an Entry are illustrated in the figure below.

ResourcePath

Collection: The name of a Collection or Service Operation (which returns a Collection of Entries) exposed by the service.
KeyPredicate: A predicate that identifies the value(s) of the key Properties of an Entry. If the Entry has a single key Property the predicate may include only the value of the key Property. If the key is made up of two or more Properties, then its value must be stated using name/value pairs. More precisely, the syntax for a KeyPredicate is shown by the following figure.
keyPredicate

NavPropSingle: The name of a Navigation Property defined by the Entry associated with the prior path segment. The Navigation Property must identify a single entity (that is, have a "to 1" relationship).
NavPropCollection: Same as NavPropSingle except it must identify a Collection of Entries (that is, have a "to many" relationship).
ComplexType: The name of a declared or dynamic Property of the Entry or Complex Type associated with the prior path segment.
Property: The name of a declared or dynamic Property of the Entry or Complex Type associated with the prior path segment.
For OData services conformant with the addressing conventions in this section, the canonical form of an absolute URI identifying a single Entry is formed by adding a single path segment to the service root URI. The path segment is made up of the name of the Collection associated with the Entry followed by the key predicate identifying the Entry within the Collection. For example the URIs "},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Categories"},{"text":"(1)/Products(1) and "},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Products"},{"text":"(1) represent the same Entry, but the canonical URI for the Entry is "},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Products"},{"text":"(1).

Same as the URI above, but identifies the "raw value" of the City property.
3.2. Addressing Links between Entries
Much like the use of links on Web pages, the data model used by OData services supports relationships as a first class construct. For example, an OData service could expose a Collection of Products Entries each of which are related to a Category Entry.

Associations between Entries are addressable in OData just like Entries themselves are (as described above). The basic rules for addressing relationships are shown in the following figure.

addressingRelationships

NavigationProperty: The name of a Navigation Property that is declared on the Entry associated with the path segment prior to the "$links" segment.
Examples

3.3. Addressing Service Operations
OData services can expose Service Operations which, like Entries, are identified using a URI. Service Operations are simple functions exposed by an OData service whose semantics are defined by the author of the function. A Service Operation can accept primitive type input parameters and can be defined to return a single primitive, single complex type, collection of primitives, collection of complex types, a single Entry, a Collection of Entries, or void. The basic rules for constructing URIs to address Service Operations and to pass parameters to them are illustrated in the following figure.

addressingServiceOperations

ServiceRootUri: The service root URI identifies the root of the OData service.
ServiceOperation: The name of a Service Operation exposed by an OData service.
ParamName: The name of a parameter accepted by the Service Operation. If the Service Operation accepts multiple parameters, the order of the parameters in the query string of the URI is insignificant.
ParamValue: The value of the parameter. The format of the value is defined by the literal form column of the table in the Abstract Types section of [OData:Core] (the OData overview specification) .

Same as the example below, except an additional parameter (param) is specified. Since the function does not define an input parameter named param, this parameter is ignored and not considered part of the function invocation.
"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/ProductColors"},{"text":"

"},{"attributes":{"line":{"listStyle":"numbered","indentLevel":1,"identifier":"FCC03915-EA3F-413C-BFBF-7DA663B6B27B","listIndex":4}},"text":"Query String Options The Query Options section of an OData URI specifies three types of information: System Query Options, Custom Query Options, and Service Operation Parameters. All OData services must follow the query string parsing and construction rules defined in this section and its subsections.
"},{"text":"
4.1. System Query Options
System Query Options are query string parameters a client may specify to control the amount and order of the data that an OData service returns for the resource identified by the URI. The names of all System Query Options are prefixed with a "$" character.

An OData service may support some or all of the System Query Options defined. If a data service does not support a System Query Option, it must reject any requests which contain the unsupported option as defined by the request processing rules in [OData:Operations].

4.2. Orderby System Query Option ($orderby)
A data service URI with a $orderby System Query Option specifies an expression for determining what values are used to order the collection of Entries identified by the Resource Path section of the URI. This query option is only supported when the resource path identifies a Collection of Entries.

The $orderby section of the normative OData specification outlines the full expression syntax supported by this query option. The examples below represent the most commonly supported subset of that expression syntax.

Examples

"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Products?$orderby=Rating"},{"text":"

All Product Entries returned in ascending order when sorted by the Rating Property.
"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Products?$orderby=Rating"},{"text":" asc

Same as the example above.
"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Products?$orderby=Rating,Category/Name"},{"text":" desc

Same as the URI above except the set of Products is subsequently sorted (in descending order) by the Name property of the related Category Entry.
4.3. Top System Query Option ($top)
A data service URI with a $top System Query Option identifies a subset of the Entries in the Collection of Entries identified by the Resource Path section of the URI. This subset is formed by selecting only the first N items of the set, where N is an integer greater than or equal to zero specified by this query option. If a value less than zero is specified, the URI should be considered malformed.

If the data service URI contains a $top query option, but does not contain a $orderby option, then the Entries in the set needs to first be fully ordered by the data service. While no ordering semantics are mandated, to ensure repeatable results, a data service must always use the same semantics to obtain a full ordering across requests.

Examples

"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Products?$top=5"},{"text":"

The first 5 Product Entries returned where the Collection of Products are sorted using a scheme determined by the OData service.
"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Products?$top=5&$orderby=Name"},{"text":" desc

The first 5 Product Entries returned in descending order when sorted by the Name property.
4.4. Skip System Query Option ($skip)
A data service URI with a $skip System Query Option identifies a subset of the Entries in the Collection of Entries identified by the Resource Path section of the URI. That subset is defined by seeking N Entries into the Collection and selecting only the remaining Entries (starting with Entry N+1). N is an integer greater than or equal to zero specified by this query option. If a value less than zero is specified, the URI should be considered malformed.

If the data service URI contains a $skip query option, but does not contain a $orderby option, then the Entries in the Collection must first be fully ordered by the data service. While no ordering semantics are mandated, to ensure repeatable results a data service must always use the same semantics to obtain a full ordering across requests.

Examples

"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Categories"},{"text":"(1)/Products?$skip=2

The set of Product Entries (associated with the Category Entry identified by key value 1) starting with the third product.
"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Products?$skip=2&$top=2&$orderby=Rating"},{"text":"

The third and fourth Product Entry from the collection of all products when the collection is sorted by Rating (ascending).
4.5. Filter System Query Option ($filter)
A URI with a $filter System Query Option identifies a subset of the Entries from the Collection of Entries identified by the Resource Path section of the URI. The subset is determined by selecting only the Entries that satisfy the predicate expression specified by the query option.

The expression language that is used in $filter operators supports references to properties and literals. The literal values can be strings enclosed in single quotes, numbers and boolean values (true or false) or any of the additional literal representations shown in the Abstract Type System section.

Note: The $filter section of the normative OData specification provides an ABNF grammar for the expression language supported by this query option.

The operators supported in the expression language are shown in the following table.

Operator    Description Example
Logical Operators
Eq  Equal   /Suppliers?$filter=Address/City eq 'Redmond'
Ne  Not equal   /Suppliers?$filter=Address/City ne 'London'
Gt  Greater than    /Products?$filter=Price gt 20
Ge  Greater than or equal   /Products?$filter=Price ge 10
Lt  Less than   /Products?$filter=Price lt 20
Le  Less than or equal  /Products?$filter=Price le 100
And Logical and /Products?$filter=Price le 200 and Price gt 3.5
Or  Logical or  /Products?$filter=Price le 3.5 or Price gt 200
Not Logical negation    /Products?$filter=not endswith(Description,'milk')
Arithmetic Operators
Add Addition    /Products?$filter=Price add 5 gt 10
Sub Subtraction /Products?$filter=Price sub 5 gt 10
Mul Multiplication  /Products?$filter=Price mul 2 gt 2000
Div Division    /Products?$filter=Price div 2 gt 4
Mod Modulo  /Products?$filter=Price mod 2 eq 0
Grouping Operators
( ) Precedence grouping /Products?$filter=(Price sub 5) gt 10
In addition to operators, a set of functions are also defined for use with the filter query string operator. The following table lists the available functions. Note: ISNULL or COALESCE operators are not defined. Instead, there is a null literal which can be used in comparisons.

Function    Example
String Functions
bool substringof(string po, string p1)  "},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/Northwind/Northwind.svc/Customers?$filter=substringof"},{"text":"('Alfreds', CompanyName) eq true
bool endswith(string p0, string p1) "},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/Northwind/Northwind.svc/Customers?$filter=endswith"},{"text":"(CompanyName, 'Futterkiste') eq true
bool startswith(string p0, string p1)   "},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/Northwind/Northwind.svc/Customers?$filter=startswith"},{"text":"(CompanyName, 'Alfr') eq true

4.6. Expand System Query Option ($expand)
A URI with a $expand System Query Option indicates that Entries associated with the Entry or Collection of Entries identified by the Resource Path section of the URI must be represented inline (i.e. eagerly loaded). For example, if you want to identify a category and its products, you could use two URIs (and execute two requests), one for /Categories(1) and one for /Categories(1)/Products. The '$expand' option allows you to identify related Entries with a single URI such that a graph of Entries could be retrieved with a single HTTP request.

The syntax of a $expand query option is a comma-separated list of Navigation Properties. Additionally each Navigation Property can be followed by a forward slash and another Navigation Property to enable identifying a multi-level relationship.

Note: The $filter section of the normative OData specification provides an ABNF grammar for the expression language supported by this query option.

Examples

"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Categories?$expand=Products"},{"text":"

Identifies the Collection of Categories as well as each of the Products associated with each Category.
Is described by the Entity Set named "Categories" and the "Products" Navigation Property on the "Category" Entity Type in the service metadata document.
"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Categories?$expand=Products/Suppliers"},{"text":"

Identifies the Collection of Categories as well as each of the Products associated with each Category. In addition, the URI also indentifies the Suppliers associated with each Product.
Is described by the Entity Set named "Categories", the "Products" Navigation Property on the "Category" Entity Type, and the "Suppliers" Navigation Property on the "Product" Entity Type in the service metadata document.
"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Products?$expand=Category,Suppliers"},{"text":"

Identifies the set of Products as well as the category and suppliers associated with each product.
Is described by the Entity Set named "Products" as well as the "Category" and "Suppliers" Navigation Property on the "Product" Entity Type in the service metadata document.
4.7. Format System Query Option ($format)
A URI with a $format System Query Option specifies that a response to the request MUST use the media type specified by the query option. If the $format query option is present in a request URI it takes precedence over the value(s) specified in the Accept request header. Valid values for the $format query string option are listed in the following table.

$format Value   Response Media Type
Atom    application/atom+xml
Xml application/xml
Json    application/json
Any other IANA-defined content type Any IANA-defined content type
A service-specific value indicating a format specific to the specific OData service Any IANA-defined content type
Examples

"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Products?$format=atom"},{"text":"

4.8. Select System Query Option ($select)
A data service URI with a $select System Query Option identifies the same set of Entries as a URI without a $select query option; however, the value of $select specifies that a response from an OData service should return a subset of the Properties which would have been returned had the URI not included a $select query option.

"},{"attributes":{"autolink":true},"text":"https://services.odata.org/OData/OData.svc/Products?$select=Price,Name"},{"text":"

# need to buy anything?

- Huawei matepad paper? It seems that I already have a lots of tablet, already got trouble to use it in the full extend\. So it seem not necessary now\. I want to have paper like feel for drawing\. - Printer \- I rarely print paper to use it at home, although ecoTank seem to be a good product

- what action / purchase can improve my learning and efficient?
- Home appliance: fan, toilet tap

- For those allocated cost, would show in related region\.

- it is quite expensive \- $5400
- actually, typing is actually faster than writing\.

### at the end I bought Mateview monitor, @$4988
as I often found that My PC don’t have enough monitor\.\.\. also it would be a good choice if I bought more Huawei product in the future

# Mother day and Family birthday \(May\)
Original intended to go hiking this morning\. However, in Mongkok, not much place to go\. Also need to send SG TB to Group finance for posting this afternoon before going to Hoi place for Hoi, Chi Ling, Pak Yin birthday and mother day\. So we didn’t go hiking\.

Today, my monitor arm also also arrived\. I can use it to attach to 2 monitors\. I make my desk have much more space\. So that I can have more working area\. I can also move the monitors\.

After the dinner, I got back home with mother by taxi\. Price around $40\.

I found that I can use 3 monitors with my Mac mini\. That’s wonderful\. I can use 2 monitors in landscape and one in portrait\. This monitor is a good place to my writing\. It can help me to write my thoughts here\.

I think it is wonderful :\)

Last week, I also purchased Apple Pencil\. So that I can again use my iPad Pro 12\.9 for drawing my ideas\.

I want to improve the daily workflow so that we can work more and better and easier\. I tool I use shall be able to help me\. I believe so\.

The monitors is flickering when I connect to 3 monitors… How to solve it?? I need to find the logic\. It seems that Lenova monitor need to have 60Hz refresh rate, otherwise, It would display properly\.

entries.text:
# The best tool for note taking
It seems to me that no device is better than paper\. Which is flexible\. I can draw picture, write Chinese, turn back to previous page to compare current writing\. Could be colorful\. More memorable\. 

But the drawback is that it’s not searchable and find what I write in the future\. And slower\. 

Today I want to keep writing to summarize what is in my mind\. I found that what I speak is lacking of substance\. 

我其實想用中文寫更多 ，因為這是的母語，更真切的表達我的想法 。如果可以的話，我希望用普通話拼音輸入法，因為可以學習更多。

要定下來好好想想 。不要總是填滿每一分一秒 。

entries.text:
# Kammy birthday

![](dayone-moment://C24059B552074EF192CA37282D82681B)

We ate at New City Plaza, 紅茶\. A branch of the same restaurant in Kwun Tong\. We ate similar foods\. Then walked along the Shing Mun River\. Thought we would then leaving\. But she proposed to eat birthday cake\. Thought she would not eat it, as she still coughing\. 

As she insisted, we went to buy cake at the same place as my birthday\. And the same cake\. And then eating at the same place\. It was hot today, I got bite many times by mini mosquito\. I wonder why the park has so many this kind of mini mosquitoes in HK\.\.\. it makes me cannot stay at the place without covering my legs and arms\.

天氣不錯，有些太陽 。我同阿媽先到，沒多久，他們也到了 。
我們聊了一會便一齊離開了 。找了一會的士站，在樂富地鐵站附近找到，然後便乘車離開了 。

# 從心出發 \- 保持天真
要從心出發，便要減少外求，要聆聽身心 。我要戒掉看日本動漫 。要看的話，多看正氣的東西 。

從現在到睡覺，我要多想多寫。在行山時，我在想，我比較專注的時候是我在做藝術的時候。那我是否應該多畫畫？但是我亦都喜歡計算，太極，邏輯，中國文化。

我想經歷一番，一路摸索，一路前行。即所謂摸看石頭過河。

# 認知覺醒
大腦
- 本能腦 \- 
- 情緒 \- 邊緣系統 （哺乳類動物）
- 理智腦

人性：避難就易，急於求成


## 耐心 \-  理智
- 是什麼？
- 要如何做到？意志力？不是的

自我探索

認知規律
- 堅信，踐行
- 始終處於舒適圈的邊緣努力
- 復利曲線

如何大耐心
- 面對天性， 不自責， 理解自己
- 自我對話， 不是不享受， 只是延遲 （有安全感） \- （深度學習）
- 後娛樂，更舒適；不能急於求成
- 找出意義，
- 享受“苦”中的“樂

entries.text:
# Make it clear by writing it down
In the early morning, I woke up and suddenly want to write down my thoughts
- It’s more fun to do programming than gaming and watching dramas or reading novel\. 
- Doing home renovations is also interesting, it’s like another form of art\. 
- 傳統中國知識，如中醫、飲食、太極、書法、陰陽五行等隔入生活，都十分有趣

每天都有很多事情發生，有很多東西想做，如果不寫下來便不能，明瞭發生了什麼，事做什麼 。正如費曼學習方法，要用自己嘅語言表達出來，才能真正得到該知識 。

致於將來能否找到自己寫下的東西，這是另外一個問題，但最少，這能內化我的知識 。

在剛過去的週末，我做了以下事項：
- 番新屋企 \- 裝了兩個吊櫃在客廳

entries.text:
# Dream and mind
In the middle of my sleep, I woke up and thought, why the word can appear clearly when I closed my eyes? Other than words, picture, movement, sound, can also be composed freely in my mind\. Can I do something to make my mind more organized? So that when I need what I want , I can get it quickly?

After that I slept again\. In another dream, I saw ‘her’ confessed to me\.

{"contents":[{"attributes":{"line":{"header":1,"identifier":"37AF630E-F0D4-47BD-845F-04FFACDF4F3E"}},"text":"Cold partially
"},{"attributes":{"line":{"header":0,"identifier":"6B432050-B051-4C98-A73B-00C34B22BE3D"}},"text":"睡眠时感到胸腹冷的原因可能有：
"},{"text":"
• 气血不足：气血不足易导致血液循环不畅，局部供血不足和体温下降，从而出现畏寒怕冷、手脚冰凉等症状，影响胸部和腹部的感觉。

• 阳虚：体内阳气不足，不能温煦机体，可能导致畏寒肢冷、面色苍白等症状。胸为阳位，腹部也易受阳虚影响，表现为睡眠时胸腹感到寒冷。

• 外感风寒：夜间睡觉时，如果没有做好保暖工作，寒气可能侵袭机体，导致胸腹发冷。

• 饮食不当：晚餐经常进食生冷类食物，可能导致胃寒，进而影响腹部的感觉。

• 胸椎小关节错位：可能导致神经受压或刺激，影响胸部的感觉和温度调节功能。

• 胸壁软组织劳损：会导致肌肉紧张和血液循环障碍，使胸壁部位处于缺氧状态，从而引起睡觉时胸口寒冷。

• 胸膜炎：由多种原因引起的胸膜壁炎症反应，炎症因子刺激周围组织，可能会导致胸腔内压力变化，影响血液循环。

• 腹部受凉：天气寒冷或者盖的被子过薄等原因可能导致寒气入侵腹部，出现腹部受凉的情况。

针对这些问题，建议注意保暖，改善饮食习惯，保持良好的生活习惯，避免过度劳累和精神紧张。若症状持续不缓解，应及时就医以确定具体原因并接受相应治疗。"}],"meta":{"created":{"platform":"com.bloombuilt.dayone-ios","version":2532},"small-lines-removed":true,"version":1}}

# ZJJ 武陵源 Day 3

![](dayone-moment://768CDE230C094C0192BE44AF94347ECB)

![](dayone-moment://0416E41526144594B849608B37006BE2)

今天目的是要走完黃石寨。

我們起於東門，走上袁家界，路徑有很多猴子及其排「沲」物 。由於前晚吃了太多油膩食物，行了一小段路便要趕去洗手間 。

但最後仍是走不完 。

晚上，又要趕回東門 。要等到天全黑才能上車到東門 。

entries.richText:
{"contents":[{"attributes":{"line":{"header":1,"identifier":"45C55D59-A71D-4781-8B1D-12EEBEE4ADA6"}},"text":"博物館

entries.text:
正氣歌 \- 文天祥
**天地有正氣，雜然賦流形。**
**下則為河嶽，上則為日星。**
**於人曰浩然，沛乎塞蒼冥。**
**皇路當清夷，含和吐明庭。**
**時窮節乃見，一一垂丹青。**
**在齊太史簡，在晉董狐筆。**
**在秦張良椎，在漢蘇武節。**
**為嚴將軍頭，為嵇侍中血。**
**為張睢陽齒，為顏常山舌。**
**或為遼東帽，清操厲冰雪。**
**或為出師表，鬼神泣壯烈。**
**或為渡江楫，慷慨吞胡羯。**
**或為擊賊笏，逆豎頭破裂。**
**是氣所磅礴，凜烈萬古存。**
**當其貫日月，生死安足論。**
**地維賴以立，天柱賴以尊。**
**三綱實系命，道義為之根。**
**嗟予遘陽九，隸也實不力。**
**楚囚纓其冠，傳車送窮北。**
**鼎鑊甘如飴，求之不可得。**
**陰房闃鬼火，春院閟天黑。**
**牛驥同一皂，雞棲鳳凰食。**
**一朝蒙霧露，分作溝中瘠。**
**如此再寒暑，百沴自辟易。**
**哀哉沮洳場，為我安樂國。**
**豈有他繆巧，陰陽不能賊。**
**顧此耿耿在，仰視浮雲白。**
**悠悠我心悲，蒼天曷有極。**
**哲人日已遠，典刑在夙昔。**
**風簷展書讀，古道照顏色。**

entries.text:
# 臣如䆠
權臣如太監，終日惶惶，只迎聖意，
众官如奮發，志必日衰，或離或躺，
此中因果，在在位者亦在權臣 。
在位者不明主次，不任人為能；
權臣不看輕重，只求迎上 。


此地不宜久留 。

One of the number shall be around 1, not 0.25, because they shall use import price, not retails price.

Even I do not open bluetooth, I still can still use my keyboard wirelessly. That's great!

# 太極拳
早上聯絡了林師父，想再學太極拳 。約了明天去學，$500/4 堂


第一章
- 太极拳开始，先练拳架。所谓拳架者，即照拳谱上各式名称，一式一式由师指教，学者悉心静气，默记揣摹，而照行之，谓之练架子。此时学者应注意内外上下：属于内者，即所谓用意不用力，下则气沉丹田，上则虚灵顶劲；属于外者，周身轻灵，节节贯串，由脚而腿而腰，沉肩屈肘等是也。初学之时，先此数句，朝夕揣摹而体会之。一式一手，总需仔细推求，举动练习，务求正确。习练既纯，再求二式，于是逐渐而至于习完。如是则毋事改正，日久亦不致更变要领也。


I want to be more calm, so that I can focus on things that really matter.

太極拳口訣


、杨氏太极拳拳势名称顺序
第一式 预备势
混沌未开太极前，摄得真精顶内煎。
提神顶劲精神注，平腕坠肘势自然

第二式 起势
沉气举手腕须平，黏缠双臂肩宜松。
按下松腹归元候，吐尽浊气清气生。

第三式 揽雀尾
一）左掤势
初运鸿濛阴阳现，起落开合太极圈。
转身左掤出左步，右采横掤任自然。
二）右掤势
架御敌手须用掤，意欲黏回勿近胸。
最忌板滞与偏抗，活泼全在转腰功。
三）￼￼捋势
顺取肘腕￼捋勿空，不抗不匾见真功。
本有舍己从人意，原为引人从己行。
￼￼四）挤势
捋势变挤顺手缠，得机发劲莫迟延。
预防敌拳又钻来，变成双掌推向前
五）按势
挤若落空变按柔，自是从人无他求。
伸腰攻步为助势，左按腕节右按肘。

揽雀尾总诀：
太极拳法妙无穷，掤￼￼捋挤按雀尾生。
掤式劲点在两臂，￼￼捋式劲点在掌中。
挤式劲点在小臂，按式劲点在腰攻。
欲知此中玄妙处，勤练推手功乃成。

第四式 单鞭
追魂钢鞭当甩胸，左像箭来右似弓。
近得身来劲变挒，靠肘掤按任君行。

第五式 提手上势
遇敌扑来胸前吼，左截右断掀彼肘。
顺引合出挤肘靠，伸腰发力敌便走。

第六式 白鹤亮翅
白鹤展翅立鸡群，左采右挒敌力分。
敞开门户引敌进，开中寓合须用心。

第七式 左搂膝拗步
起肩过胯膝外搂，肘外须防敌暗手。
连环接打斜中找，掌按侧肋并肩头。

第八式 手挥琵琶
双手如抱一琵琶，折肘剪腕用不差。
里外圈儿由我划，左挒右采破擒拿。

第九式 左右搂膝拗步
第十式 手挥琵琶
第十一式 左搂膝拗步

第十二式 进步搬拦捶
太极五捶此为先，搬拦左右顾盼间。
护中反打进步捶，化后即打非等闲。

第十三式 如封似闭
扬掌格肘十字封，开化合手闭含攻。
推按顺防刹不住，哼哈之间腰腿功。

第十四式 十字手
扣脚即寓裆中击，转身掤开敌两臂。
缠拿裹封开合手，相机变化莫迟疑。

第十五式 抱虎归山
十字手开采挒上，抱虎全凭力臂长。
盼前顾后搂按打，趁势￼￼￼捋挤也难防。

第十六式 肘底看捶
左掤右粘护中打，捶居肘下叶底花。
缠托折叠掌劈面，肘底相机破擒拿。

第十七式 左右倒撵猴
轻灵撤步似水流，引而后发倒卷肱。
走化闪战扳挽劲，惊走猴王佛心留。

第十八式 斜飞势
右腕被捉本无妨，翻掌下沉即消殃。
左采右挒抖然出，侧身腾出亦飞扬。

第十九式 提手上势
第二十式 白鹤亮翅
第二十一式 左搂膝拗步

第二十二式 海底针
倘逢敌手钳右腕，引敌进身坠千斤。
右拿左压采挽劲，仆前跌后俯仰功。

第二十三式 扇通背
右臂滚提托架功，背连双臂劲贯通。
噫嘘一口丹田气，劲点原在腰际冲。

第二十四式 撇身捶
横截敌臂闪正中，左掌防头伸可攻。
翻拳压带莫丢劲，掌推敌肘展无空。

第二十五式 进步搬拦捶
第二十六式 上步揽雀尾
第二十七式 单鞭

第二十八式 云手
掤￼￼￼￼捋采挒挤按推，全凭腰脊圆转随。
云到敌人双肘后，铜墙铁柱一齐推。

第二十九式 单鞭

第三十式 高探马
左带右探济阴阳，扑面锁喉此势良。
转手高攀马头拧，舒肩拔臂收腹腔。

第三十一式 左右分脚
上步半￼￼￼￼捋￼化敌空，采腕掀肘护我胸。
重心放低宜沉气，分脚踢出势须平。

第三十二式 转身左蹬脚
忽觉背后敌来攻，转身消打眼要明。
先合后开意中定，手拦脚蹬着腰功

第三十三式 左右搂膝拗步

第三十四式 进步栽捶
栽捶原为打下盘，左手大搂要当先，
进步拳追敌难躲，总击敌腹腰腿间。

第三十五式 翻身撇身捶
第三十六式 进步搬拦捶
第三十七式 右蹬脚

第三十八式 左打虎势
第三十九式 右打虎势
猛虎扑来势虽凶，采￼巨臂敌势空。
忽转腰胯翻拳打，左右披身伏虎精。

第四十式 回身右蹬脚
第四十一式 双峰贯耳
第四十二式 左蹬脚
遇敌推按休着慌，手叠敌臂压彼掌。
向外掤架上右步，力贯双拳取太阳。

第四十三式 转身右蹬脚

第四十四式 进步搬拦捶
敌逼左侧近身前，我忽退步右转圈。
分手格握身蓄势，左蹬右踹步连环。

第四十五式 如封似闭
第四十六式 十字手
第四十七式 抱虎归山
第四十八式 斜单鞭

第四十九式 野马分鬃
斜单鞭后此势连，先采后挒左右环。
弓步助势攻腋下，肩靠肘打逼近旋。

第五十式 揽雀尾
第五十一式 单鞭

第五十二式 玉女穿梭
转身顺掤拗手击，双臂斜穿肘后齐。
旋肘摇化走内劲，贴身滚挤莫相离。

![](dayone-moment://173CC24E686E41A9BEF5343959179FDB)

第五十三式 揽雀尾
第五十四式 单鞭
第五十五式 云手
第五十六式 单鞭
第五十七式 下势
下势避敌转腰胯，手似采蝶下寻花。
逆收顺采皆由我，退进自如用不差。

第五十八式 金鸡独立
顺势跟进蛰龙现，擎掌托肘敌臂弯。
下跺脚背勿轻用，提膝休撞下丹田。

第五十九式 左右倒撵猴
第六十式 斜飞势
第六十一式 提手上势
第六十二式 白鹤亮翅
第六十三式 左搂膝拗步
第六十四式 海底针
第六十五式 扇通背
第六十六式 转身白蛇吐信
第六十七式 搬拦捶
第六十八式 揽雀尾
第六十九式 单鞭
第七十式 云手
第七十一式 单鞭

第七十二式 高探马带穿掌
右手探马以高强，谁料左手又穿掌。
胸前护肘靠右手，左脚跟进又难防。

第七十三式 十字腿
第七十四式 进步指裆捶
第七十五式 上步揽雀尾
第七十六式 单鞭
第七十七式 下势

第七十八式 上步七星
上步七星变无穷，看似防守实寓攻。
远打近靠中出肘，前踢旁踹膝上冲。

第七十九式 退步跨虎
上压下踢来势欢，退步闪战莫迟缓。
圆转两臂任开合，粘连黏随稳如盘。

第八十式 转身摆莲
前封后打进腿攻，势如旋风平地生。
采￼￼￼￼捋￼￼敌臂粘缠劲，连环横扫锉敌锋。

第八十一式 弯弓射虎
敌进双拳打我胸，右提左拂似挽弓。
紧贴敌臂回劲放，当头炮加左拳冲。

第八十二式 进步搬拦捶
第八十三式 如封以闭
第八十四式 十字手

第八十五式 收势
太极无始亦无终，阴阳相济奇妙生。
走即粘来粘即走，攻变守来守变攻。
知己知彼无不胜，熟着熟劲见神明。
任他鼎力来势猛，引进入空智胜勇

entries.text:
# 太極 \- 內外三合
肘與膝合，肩與胯合

太极拳中的“内外三合”是拳术核心理论之一，体现了形神兼备、内外统一的修炼要求，分为“外三合”与“内三合”。以下为具体解析：

---

### 一、外三合：形体协调
外三合强调肢体动作的协调配合，是外形运动的基本法则：

1. **肩与胯合**
	- 肩关节与胯关节上下垂直对齐，转动时同步呼应。例如：弓步时前肩与前胯合，后肩与后胯合，保持中正不歪斜。
2. **肘与膝合**
	- 肘部与膝盖动作相互照应。如“搂膝拗步”中，前手肘与前膝方向一致，形成合力。
3. **手与足合**
	- 手指与脚趾的动向协调。如“云手”时，手部左移则左脚亦随之移动，上下同步。

​**作用**​：外三合保证动作结构稳定，发力顺畅，避免散乱。

---

### 二、内三合：神意主导
内三合注重精神、气息与劲力的内在整合：

1. **心与意合**
	- 心静专一，意念清晰。练拳时摒除杂念，以意识引导动作（如“意到气到”）。
2. **意与气合**
	- 意念调动内气运行。例如：吸气时意存丹田，呼气时意贯四梢（手脚末端）。
3. **气与力合**
	- 内气与劲力相合，形成“内劲”。如发劲时以气催力，松柔中透刚猛。

​**作用**​：内三合是内功基础，培养“以意导气，以气运身”的能力。

---

### 三、内外相合的关系
- ​**外三合为形，内三合为神**​：外形协调需以内意为主导，内意通过外形体现。
- ​**练习次第**​：初学先求外三合（动作规范），再逐步融入内三合（意念、呼吸）。
- ​**高阶体现**​：内外合一时，动作如行云流水，劲力绵长不断，达到“形神合一”之境。

---

### 四、实践要点
1. ​**外三合练习**​：通过单式反复校正肩胯、肘膝、手足的联动（如“揽雀尾”）。
2. ​**内三合培养**​：站桩（如“无极桩”）时专注呼吸与意念，体会“松沉”与“气感”。
3. ​**常见误区**​：
	- 只重外形，忽略内意，导致动作空洞；
	- 过度追求内气，忽视基本功，造成虚实不分。

---

​**总结**​：太极拳的“内外三合”是循序渐进的过程，需在明师指导下反复体悟，最终达到“一动无有不动，一合无有不合”的整体状态。

# 十一堂，刀，丹田
1. 慢練
2. 丹田，提肛，放鬆；
3. 吳式單鞭

刀
1. 起勢
2. 上步七星
3. 退步跨虎
4. 提膝，弓步交刀
5. 右劈，後瓜刀，提膝
6. 弓步，後插

在氣功修練中， *「丹田」是一個核心概念* ，它並不是一個具體的器官，而是一個能量中心，與人體的氣、精、神密切相關。

🌿 *丹田的分類與位置*
氣功理論中通常將丹田分為三個部位：

- *下丹田* ：位於肚臍下約一寸半至三寸之間，是最常被提及的丹田。它被視為人體的「氣海」，是儲存與培養元氣的地方⁽¹⁾⁽²⁾。
- *中丹田* ：位於胸腔中央，膻中穴附近，與心肺功能、情緒調節有關⁽²⁾。
- *上丹田* ：位於兩眉之間的印堂穴內部，與精神、意識、思維活動相關⁽²⁾。

🔥 *丹田的作用*

- 是氣功修練中「聚氣、養氣、化氣」的關鍵部位。
- 被視為任督衝三脈的交匯點，是「真氣」運行的起點⁽¹⁾。
- 在修練過程中，透過呼吸與意念引導氣沉丹田，有助於穩定情緒、增強體力與內在能量⁽¹⁾。

🧘 *為什麼叫「丹田」？*
「丹」原指煉丹術中的仙藥，象徵精華與能量；「田」則象徵耕耘與培養之地。合起來，「丹田」就是培養內在能量的「田地」——透過長期修練，讓氣在此處凝聚、轉化，進而提升身心狀態。

entries.text:
# Management efficiency \- 用表格管理 \- 大西農夫明

當主管，工作太多做不完，該怎麼辦？
部屬有的忙翻，有的裝忙，要如何處理？
現狀輿貝標有落差，該改善哪個環節？

日本現場管理大師大西農关明強調。主管
最重要的職責是績效管理。學
會「表格管理」的技巧，不僅工作立刻減少40%，還能瞬間提升效率和績效。這樣神奇的工作圖解術，當主管一定要會！

- 繪製工作分解圖，確定目標和任務，建立管理點。有人實務操作、有人監督指導，一發現落差，就知道問題出在哪裡。
- 將個人工作分析或塔配「工作改善原則」，用取消、合併、重排、簡化的手法，減少工作量。
• 依據主管工作分派表，把業務交辦出去，部屬還能準時下班。
• 使用作業時間比較表，按部就班執行任務，不拖延、也不浪費時間。
•運用主管和部屬的月報表以及「管理循環」，持續提高部門績效。

這套工作圖解術，集結作者20年的顧問經驗與祕訣，幫助你掌握主管的關鍵任務，從此綠達成目標要做什麼、怎麼做、要花多少時間，讓團隊不再出現溝通障礙，你更成為最具競爭力的主管！

# 3 weeks ago I decided to rejoin Achievers
I took annual leave every Monday from the end of Jul to the end of Aug\. I wanted to clear my annual leave and also clear my mind\. 
To find out the path and I want to go and in the process to improve myself\. 

I haven’t written for a long time\. Because I do not have motivation to do it\. However, since I’m starting to speak on stage, I have to write more, to make it clear what I want to speak\. 

It is often easier to writing in general in daily life than forcing myself to make a speech on purpose\.

Chekhov's gun - necessary, important elements

- Movie (intro)

    - it was exciting ... even from its title (Focus - gesture)
    - , in the Climax - Gorilla Eddie emitting laser beam from his eyes (body gesture), and Fantastic Irene breathing fire from her mouth
    - at that exciting moment, my phone was ringing (unhappy) .... hello...
    - return to the movie, they were shaking hands, and befriended , joining toastmasters meeting together tonight ...
    - Do you know what's the moral of the story?
    - Not to miss the important part, turn off the distraction
- Ladies and Gentlemen, ever got distracted in cinema?
- in a speech, we also have some distraction, called unnecessary sounds, such as ah um er, you know,... it's not Chekhov's gun, it hinders us from hearing your message
- My role - record, report
- speakers tonight - be aware of it and turn off your unnecessary sounds, (body gesture)
    - Won't miss your message
- Back to you, chairman

entries.text:
# Cooking red rice
Of course! Cooking red rice congee (porridge) is easy, but achieving a soft, creamy texture requires one crucial step because red rice has a tougher, fibrous bran layer than white rice.
Here is a detailed guide on how to cook perfect red rice congee.
### **The Golden Rule: Soak First!**
Unlike white rice, **red MUST be soaked** before cooking to soften the grains and reduce the cooking time. Soak for at least **4 hours**, or ideally **overnight**.
* * *
### **Method 2: Rice Cooker (Easiest & Hands-Off)**
This is the most convenient method for a worry-free meal.
**Instructions:**
1. **Soak:** Don't skip this step, even for a pressure cooker. Soak the red rice as described above.

2. **Combine:** Place the drained rice, water, and any add-ins (like dates or sweet potato) into the inner pot of your appliance.

3. mix 1/5 white rice for better texture

4. **Cook:**

    - **Standard Rice Cooker:** Use the "Porridge" or "Congee" setting. If it doesn't have one, use the regular "Cook" setting and let it run for a full cycle. Check the consistency afterward; you may need to run a second short cycle.

    

5. **Release Pressure:** Once cooking is complete, allow the pressure to **release naturally (NPR)** for at least 10-15 minutes before turning the valve. This is key for a creamy texture.

6. **Season:** Open the lid, stir well, and season as desired.


* * *
### **Pro Tips for Success**
- **Toppings are Key:**

    - **Sweet:** Fresh fruit, nuts, seeds, a splash of coconut milk.

    - **Savory:** Sliced green onions, fresh cilantro, crispy fried shallots, a soft-boiled egg, or shredded chicken.

    

- **Water Ratio:** The ratio is flexible. **1:8** is a standard starting point, but adjust to your preferred thickness. Remember, it will continue to thicken as it cools.

- 
- play football / basketball
- missed??

Repeat \- self study
- Chase for the missing time 
- Want to work

3 long vacations in my life\. longest, to the shortest

In a period of time, 
Unlike others travelers, I stopped there\.\.\.


Time \- one year
Repeat a year to take the exam again \-
- public exam \- HKAL \- \.\.\. self study \- 
- From Monday to Sunday, \.\.\.
- keep fit \.\.\.
	- search from website, master Eddy, tai chi \(that was my childhood dream\.\.\.\)
	- ranked 2nd place ? same last name

make up the missing time, \.\.\.
Jun 2013, Dec 2021
9 years, 18 exams \- Airport
- Learn 1 thing \- I don’t want to have any exam ever and ever again
- Cannot rush to get there
- I want to learn something that I like \- 
- If I can practice one thing for more than 20 years, and can still find areas of improvement, why not give me a chance to 

These 2 vacation more or less affecting me\.

a few months ago, texted master Eddy, \.\.\.

Get a stronger body again, after more than 20 years of practice, I can still find area of improvement\.

I have always want to build something\.

36 days of annual leave in previous years, every Monday\.\.\.
- 
- 

When I were young, when I want to work, when I am getting older I want to play more\. 

Skydiving vs public speaking \->
Recently,
Think about myself \- self reflection

Let’s slay\.

# Long vacation
Summer time has passed\.\.\.  

Summer holiday \- 
- Little boy, full of curiosity, \.\.\. 
- Delved into the territory for man\.\.\. read novel about war, Jin Yung Wuxia novel \.\. hero slaying bad guys\.\.\.

Space out\.\.\. 

HKALE \- Hong Kong Advanced Level Examination \.\.\. that was an entrance exam for university study\.

Didn’t satisfy with my result, \-\-> Self\-study a year \-

- Keep health \- sunny and raining, Kung Fu\.\.\. master \- Eddy
- Learn Tai chi once a week
- Practice twice daily

I felt that I become healthier, stronger \(balance,  and more focused in my daily activities\.

Wanted to chase for the losing time \.\.\. After graduation, I was thirsty for work\.\.\. 

Enter into \.\.\. 
- Work 

---

Every half year, I would 
Another time \.\.\. 
Repeating study\.\.\. for an exam \.\.\. last for 

Taxation \- once
Financial reporting \- twice
Business finance \- twice
Business assurance \- 6 times
Final exam \- 10 times

9 years 5 exam\. 
1 \+ 2 \+2 \+ 6 \+ 10 = 23 examination in 9 years\. Failed 18 times\.

- 1st \- I don’t like exam
- Allowed each failure to demotivate me\.
- Prepare better\.

At last, a few years ago, I complete

---

I have been practicing tai chi since the day I first learned it, for more than 20 years\.\.\. 
Earlier this year, after more than 20 years skipping the class, I called Master Eddy, start learning tai chi again  \.\.\. can find a lots of area of improvement, can still find a lots of fun from that\. 

Getting used to failure in 
I started to think recently
- If I can keep on failing for so many times, why not try again for the area I want to improve
- If I practicing tai chi for more than 20 years, can still have fun and find area of improvement, why not practice more on public speaking\. 


Public speaking 

Let’s slay

---

Adding humour is to help deliver the message, not the make it complicated and less memorable\.

entries.text:
# Long vacation
Do you like vacation?
How long was your longest vacation?

I will share something about me in 3 of my longest vacation, and explain why I rejoin Achievers\.

---

My first vacation lasted for ​==a year==​, \.\.\.

Self\-study \- University Entrance exam

many years ago, I took my ==entrance exam== to the university\.\. I wasn't satisfied with my performance , so retook it\. Self\-study for a year\.

\- a long vacation before my university study
\- at that time I felt that my body was getting weaker\.

Here was my ​**==plan==**​ to deal with both\.\.\.
\- study 12 hours a day\. 
\- everytime when I finished a chapter or a target, I would do 30 \- 50 push up, 30 sit up, while doing it, sum up what I have learnt\.
\- daily, would go running / hiking for 5km to breathe some fresh air, to have an overall conclusion what I have learnt, or solve the problem that I couldn't solve\.
\- the exercise seem not balance enough to me, I took the opportunity to pursue one of my childhood dreams, to learn Chinese Kung Fu\.\.\. the one that I learnt is popular \-\-\- called Tai Chi\. I always found it to be beautiful and sophisticated\.

I searched from the web and found master Eddy\. Learnt from him once a week for a year and practice it twice a day\. 

After a year, the result of the exam was fine\. I got a ​==stronger body==​ and entered into an university\.

---

HKICPA exam\.

my next long vacation was started around 10 years later\.\.\. spanned for 9 years\. last for around 160 days\. 

This time, I was really travelling, and ​==travelled a lots==​\. 

It was started in an early morning, sunny day, I packed my luggage, heading to the airport\. 

I travelled further away from the airport, not to another country, but to the next mtr station ​==asia world expo==​\. 

I unpacked My luggage filled with the studying materials for certified accounting exam\.\.\. 

I am living in TKO, it took me 3 hours to travel back and fro\. \.\.\. the exam conducted every half year \.\.\. 

it took me 9 years 18 attempts \.\.\. to reach the final destination, passed all the papers\.\.\.

The total travelling time was 18 x 3 hours = 54 hours \.\.\.I checked deepseek\.\.  if I were taking plane with the same time it was enough to travel around the world\. 

It was really a long long travel and vacation\. I learnt one crucial thing from this vacation \-\- I don't like exam\.

---

Half year ago, I finally got some leisure time, 

I decided to pursue my childhood dream again \- I ​==reached master Eddy==​\. Texted him I wanted to learn tai chi again\. To my delighted, he is still alive \.\.\. and teaching\. I found that after 20 years of practice, I can still find areas of improvement and still like it\. 

It made me thought that if I can ==practice== tai chi for more than 20 years, can learn to control my body from head to toe, 
why not practice more before speaking on stage ? they both require practice and body control\. 

I left Achievers 6 years ago,  because my office relocated away from HK Island, it is not convenient to get here\. 

But if I could, ==fail== the exam so many times, why not fail on stage again\. 

That's why I am taking my ​==3rd long vacation==​ here in Achievers\.\.\. 

This vacation will be lasted for 36 days, on each Monday\. at some point I might reach the ==destination== I sought for \.\.\.

"},{"embeddedObjects":[{"type":"horizontalRuleLine"}]},{"text":"HKICPA exam.

my next long vacation was started around 10 years later... spanned for 9 years. last for around 160 days. 

This time, I was really travelling, and "},{"attributes":{"highlightedColor":"ffc107cc"},"text":"travelled a lots"},{"text":". 

It was started in an early morning, sunny day, I packed my luggage, heading to the airport. 

I travelled further away from the airport, not to another country, but to the next mtr station "},{"attributes":{"highlightedColor":"ffc107cc"},"text":"asia world expo"},{"text":". 

I unpacked My luggage filled with the studying materials for certified accounting exam... 

I am living in TKO, it took me 3 hours to travel back and fro. ... the exam conducted every half year ... 

it took me 9 years 18 attempts ... to reach the final destination, passed all the papers...

The total travelling time was 18 x 3 hours = 54 hours ...I checked deepseek..  if I were taking plane with the same time it was enough to travel around the world. 

It was really a long long travel and vacation. I learnt one crucial thing from this vacation -- I don't like exam."},{"embeddedObjects":[{"type":"horizontalRuleLine"}]},{"text":"Half year ago, I finally got some leisure time, 

I decided to pursue my childhood dream again - I "},{"attributes":{"highlightedColor":"ffc107cc"},"text":"reached master Eddy"},{"text":". Texted him I wanted to learn tai chi again. To my delighted, he is still alive ... and teaching. I found that after 20 years of practice, I can still find areas of improvement and still like it. 

It made me thought that if I can "},{"attributes":{"highlightedColor":"ffc107cc"},"text":"practice"},{"text":" tai chi for more than 20 years, can learn to control my body from head to toe, 
why not practice more before speaking on stage ? they both require practice and body control. 

I left Achievers 6 years ago,  because my office relocated away from HK Island, it is not convenient to get here. 

But if I could, "},{"attributes":{"highlightedColor":"ffc107cc"},"text":"fail"},{"text":" the exam so many times, why not fail on stage again. 

That's why I am taking my "},{"attributes":{"highlightedColor":"ffc107cc"},"text":"3rd long vacation "},{"text":"here in Achievers... 

This vacation will be lasted for 36 days, on each Monday. at some point I might reach the "},{"attributes":{"highlightedColor":"ffc107cc"},"text":"destination"},{"text":" I sought for ..."}],"meta":{"created":{"platform":"com.bloombuilt.dayone-ios","version":2631},"small-lines-removed":true,"version":1}}

# time keeper
 \- Important, interesting resources\. 
- Girlfriend or boyfriend 
- To have more vs too much
- Signals 
- White board, 
- Report

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
time is an important resource \.\.\. it's also an interesting resource, \.\.\.just like girlfriends \.\.\.
\- sometime you may want to have more; the other time you may feel it is too much;
\- because of its subjective nature, I'm here to give you signal to have adequate timing on stage
\.\.\.\.
Green \- ~~2 min left \-~~ can have more; 
Amber \- ~~1 min \-~~ still okay; 
Red \- ~~time up \-~~ enough; 
Ding \- ~~30 sec overrun \-~~ too much
\.\.\.\.
~~similarly, for other speeches shorter than 3 min, like TT speech~~ 
~~Green \- 1 min; Amber 30 sec; Red time's up\.~~ 
\.\.\.\.\.
The signal I give is depending on the length of your alloted time\.

e\.g\. for the benefit of our guests, if you are picked in our table topic section, you have 2 minutes to speak on stage\.
1 min, green; 30 sec, amber; times up, red\.
\.\.\.\.\.\.
report at the end of meeting how well you manage your time\.
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

observation\.\.\.\.

entries.text:
# To continue 活出真我
Doubt,
Difficulty is not at the beginning , but from how to continue, and be better
Lingering fear, expectation \-> work , don’t run away, fun, different aspects

recently, I'm taking leaves to learn more about myself\.
what I want? where do I want to go? how can I move on\.

I found that I have doubt all the times\.
But if that's the direction I decided to go, no matter how much doubt I  have\. I shall go for it\. 
My heart will not stop questioning myself\.\.\. similarly the world could also questioning me\.\.\.
when I were on stage, \.\.\. look at the face\.\.\. make it fluent, so that I can feel what it is like\. If I'm too busy to deliver my speech, then I would miss the feeling\. The feeling is important, to allow me to improve it in the next stage time\.

When can i have a peaceful mind? 
\- as long as I don't satisfy with the current state, as long as I explore more,
\- I shall always face the doubt\.
\- but I can't stop because of the past failure or because I have never done it\.
\- who do I want to be? 
\- as long as I'm alive, I shall not give up\.
\- to live the life that I naturally want to be\.

entries.text:
# writing
if I want to improve on my communication skill. I shall keep using the language. No matter whether I have anything to start to write, I shall pick a time a day to write. And keep on writing it, just like table topic question.
This way, I think I can train myself to be more ready to speak and communicate impromptuly.

Recently, I have been planning on my life. one of the crucial aspect of my life is "Tai Chi" or Martial Art. I want to be stronger physically, so that I can have the powerhouse to keep my performance, with quality. Also because I like it, I think I can keep on improving it.

From Apr 2025 to now, I think I have learnt a lots in this area.
- improvement on the horsestand,
- shifting the weight
- moving hip joints, not the waist
- breathing

For new moves
- warm up exercise
- Tai Chi Sabre
- improve the moves of tai chi quan

Nothing could be done immediately without work. So keep on it.

I know that I have many hours were wasted on things that doesn't matter. That's why if I can replace it with things that matter, I shall be able to improve faster. Talk more with myself in writing.

中文拼音是很有趣。
有問題， 沒問題，好吧，可以不可以

I like to type like this as well. This posture is relaxing. the keyboard is light and responsive.

Jennifer encourage me to join Cantonese Humorous speech contest.
So where shall I start? Actually, I wouldn't have much chance to speak Cantonese on stage, so no reservation is needed.

秘密武器，
- 練習
-

職業

－－－－－－－－－
當我練習太極拳的時候我在想，如果我好像太極拳那樣多練習，我會如何？如果我有方向的練習，又會如何？
所以我決定從現在開始

j - 姐姐經濟解決拒絕久久掘金僵局基金積極
q - 親親親戚全球七千秦腔前期悄悄
x - 謝謝學校學習信息休息消息相信

z - 這種正在政治張振紫竹裝醉昭昭罪責
c - 從此尺寸吃醋出差瞅瞅蟲草初春
s - 試試宿舍三十說說收拾三生失手師叔邵氏三十四
r - 讓人仍然若若融入柔軟容忍軟弱如若

zh - 政治昭昭作者張振這種症狀灼灼
sh - 邵氏失手收拾師叔說說是是是試試

a - 愛啊
o - 喔噢
e - 二兒餓而
i -
u

b - 寶貝拜拜爸爸白板表白八百
p - 品牌婆婆匹配裴裴偏偏胖胖批評
m - 秘密媽媽妹妹慢慢沒門夢寐買命
f - 防範方法豐富反復仿佛腓腓發放夫婦

d - 弟弟對的地點等等到底顛倒登頂多大
t - 天天偷偷頭疼聽聽天臺頭痛天堂
n - 那你你呢奶奶你能囡囡牛奶南寧
l - 來了流量累了聊聊來啦老啦寥寥遛遛落雷

g - 哥哥剛剛乖乖尷尬光顧港股廣告改革
k - 看看開口可靠開課夸克坎坷曠課口渴
h - 哈哈😁好好呵護黃花洪荒和合悔婚還好

w - 問我娃娃吻我五萬旺旺威武
y - 語音一樣雨衣友誼醫院雲野燕雲銀翼

拼音打字
今天我決定去用多一點我的文字，所以我決定改一改我的日常，
平時我花太多時間在視頻上，這比不做如何東西還不好。
如果我可以懂得普通話拼音，那麼我可以更好更快的表達我的想法。這是我一路而來多年的想法。

但我看到它的潛力，所以我不悔。s

entries.text:
平凡的世界
愛，生活，家人，成長，貧窮，
既然我的每一天都是，決定在我的心上的，為何不好好的過？
今天的幸福是從前的人努力結果，所以我們都是有負擔的。為了下一代更好的生活去努力。
我可以做些什麼？只有自己想得到。
孫少平，今天好熱... 迷茫，如果真理是越變越明，那麼我多寫一點會不會更好的想法。

政治。李，痛苦，心不在焉，一排，
工作，秘書，幹事，從，讀書，不讀書，不看報，.... 一天也過不來了，
田李樓，大黑貓，還好，不過也不成了。牙疼不是病，愛人，三個女人，喝酒，娃娃，保重，許国
小，他們的臉，什麼都沒說，田福堂，心裡什麼都，大吃一驚，娃娃，大官，活活氣死，不吃，愛一般的，第二天，中午看見花壇，金黃，

平平整整一乾二淨，高老，七十歲，記憶力，本縣人，酒菜，興致勃勃

entries.text:
# Table topics - follow your nose, Hunch
follow my instinct, to write anything in my head. Find something intertesting to share during the meeting. I can still practice such table topics before meeting. My core principle is still unchanged. To build myself.

-------
- far-fetching? passion, realistic goal
- deep breath, automatically, and voluntarily control ， dual control system...
- fast and short breaths, high rate heart break, dangerous
- deep breath, send a signal to the brain, no longer in danger.

if your are nervous, take a deep breath, and then walk to the stage
-----
follow your nose, speak, ...
- think before speak, start speak, stop at some point
- water flow
- where is the ingredients for me to speak? reading \<\> speaking, becuase it hasn't been become yours. so during these Monday Leave, connecting the dots, formulate the structure or connection of my knowledge. Use it as a base for my future development.

give some topics to myself, see if I can make it a speech.
1. follow your nose - definition, follow instinct, sins - pride, greed, wrath, envy, lust, gluttony, and sloth
--- being in jail...?
sniff.. sniff...
2. cold... in air conditioning room... go outdoor, under the mild breezing wind, I was typing.
3. food ... sour taste... foul smell
4. unwell ...

hiking
- usually, I would follow the standard trial, clear route and sign post (distance sign), 500m,
- dangerous ...warning sign...

-------
respiratory system...?
nose - control it, and can also let it run itself,
- breathe, ... deep breath - relax
- heart beating fast

when you are stuck, you can follow your nose.
Training to follow my nose, instinct.

not follow enough...

-----
hiking in Hong Kong is quite convenient and safe.
- major trails - well maintained, distance post every 500m. Wilson trails, Maclehose, Lantau trails, Hong Kong trails.
- don't need to follow your nose... follow the posts
- follow google map...
－－－
lose my sense...
tidy up, not adding, but organizing, relating, building.
------
principle behind it. reason behind it.
- biological? physical? mental?
- why people have preference.
1. gene, 2. environment

--------

hunch 1. verb 2. guess base on intuition not fact

----
connecting the dots.
----
questions being asked most often and I couldnt' answer
1. why did I change from Engineer to Accountant?
2. are you single?
3. how old are you?

---
Hiking
- walking from home to primary school, 20 min
- walk up the slope...

- secondary school, 45 min

- university, 30 min
- review while I was walking... or solving problem..

**use the inconvenience** - make it as your advantages
------

testing material... myself... you...
- induction -\> hypothesis or theory -\> deduction -\> testing -\> back to induction
- question / observation -\> hypothesis -\> experiment (control group) -\> data -\> analysis -\> conclusion

－－－
moving house, relocate
- instinct? knowledge
- combine / dissect
- cycle

enough, need to work again. Keep on writing, don't let it stop for 15 minutes.
-----------

To prepare something interesting to speak...

---------
from nothing to something ... from something to something more. and organized.
scientific ways of thinking and developing.

conservation of energy... close system... output.
something cannot be seen, how can I find it and make it appearing to the others, in an organized way?

hide it so well? no trace of evidence it was ever exist in my head.
question -\> answer ... twist --\> answer
so what's the trigger? can I use the trigger to get what I want to talk?
What. when, why where, how
feeling, description,

how to make it more interesting? in my storage, I would organize it, but if I present it, I would need to modify it if I intend to make it more interesting. So how, to do it in a short time?
to combine 2 pools of information, it could be interesting.

unlike examination, there is no single correct answer. I can give whatever answer I have in my mind. Develop it to be the best I can at the moment.

dissect, reorganize

--------
speaking
- most efficient and convenient way.
- choose not to speak unless
1. most efficient,
2. it's the only way
---
there are times that I have to speak, if I do not prepare, then when the time come, I would be speechless.

--------
table topic - interesting
- career?
- speech?

# Kammy Lee
她是我的同事。但是我們的關係比較複雜。
其實，我也不記得在什麼時候發生，

我應該繼續還是停止。
在我心中，我希望有一個正常的妻子，小孩，家.... 如果我爭取，不一定有，但是也總好過繼續這種生活。但是好像會令到她不開心。她不是一個壞人，衹是我們不適合。

如果拒絕她的話，她會好好過活嗎？我希望她是幸福的...

entries.text:
Slasher.... Storyteller.. - Maththew Dicks
Storytelling - master class
finding and telling storytelling
FBI... hostage..
## crafting stories
1. A Story - Spoon - Jimmy, power

2. how to do it?

    - What constitutes a story? not report your life

        - transformation

        - realization

        - change over time

        

    - Creating a frame for your story

        - find your moment of transformation (the point, the end)

        - find the opposite of your moment of transformation (e.g. romantic comedy, super hero)

        

    - Beginning of your story, bad beginning not get people on your plane

        - start as close to the end as possible

        - begin with location and action (take the image, )

        - avoid exposition (not teaching start)

        - avoid preambles (e.g. don't say it is the funniest things in your life, it was amazing ...)

        - create a sense of wonder (metal object, not spoon)

        

    - How to entertain

        - stakes - what worry about / wonder about, different people, different time etc.

            - what do you want, need, worried about etc.

            

        - surprise - delightful, joyous, shocking, unforgettable, heart-pounding (remember when you were surprise)

            - avoid preambles

            - misdirect

            

        - Suspense (between stakes and surprise)

            - exclusion of certain bits of information alongside the strategic and purposeful inclusion of certain bits of information

            

        

    - Three very best choices in life - not giving everything at once..

        - 1\. become a Yankees fan; 2. adopt cats 3. give a

        

    - Humor, helpful, but not necessary

ascent, don't worry, as long as it is comprehensible

not kill the joy, not forget about the basic.

we are not robot.
Organic growth.

work

work

writing

in such case, tai chi shall be around 9:30pm.

How long shall I read? I think whenever I finish a chapter, I shall stop and write.

virtual computer.

can I do the same with 拼音？

one of the good things about writing outside is that I can get some new idea from the people or things, or animal passing by. It could stimulate me to think. it is just like daily life. Just that when i'm walking, I can write at the same time.

· Ace (often abbreviated A)

The cards from 2 through 10 are often called "pip cards" or "number cards." The Jack, Queen, and King are called "face cards" or "court cards."

The Suits

A standard deck has four suits:

· Hearts (♥)
· Diamonds (♦)
· Clubs (♣)
· Spades (♠)

Full Card Names

To name a specific card, you combine the rank with the suit. For example:

· Ace of Spades
· King of Hearts

· Jack of Clubs
· 10 of Hearts

· Ace: Can often be used as a low card (below 2) or a high card (above King), depending on the game.

Collective Names for Groups of Cards:

· A pair = Two cards of the same rank (e.g., two Kings).
· Three of a kind = Three cards of the same rank.

· A full house = Three of a kind and a pair.

"},{"text":"好的，楊式太極劍的招式優美、舒展大方，兼具健身與防身的功能。其劍法特點是「以柔克剛」、「以巧制勝」，強調身劍合一，用意不用力。

以下是楊式太極劍的主要招式名稱，按照常見的練習順序排列，並附上簡要說明。

楊式太極劍主要招式（五十四式常見套路）

轉身，護腕。分手，發勁 。
預備式 & 起勢

"},{"attributes":{"line":{"identifier":"23721F4C-F729-45DB-B452-0E1D2113755C","indentLevel":1,"listIndex":1,"listStyle":"numbered"}},"text":"預備式：自然站立，心靜體鬆，劍持於左手中。
"},{"attributes":{"line":{"identifier":"AE54DEF2-BDF6-4EA3-89E7-53DC07F7A5E8","indentLevel":1,"listIndex":2,"listStyle":"numbered"}},"text":"起勢：開步、接劍，準備開始。
"},{"text":"

· 身劍協調：強調「以身帶劍」，腰是主宰，帶動四肢運劍，做到「身劍合一」。
· 意氣相隨：練習時要精神集中，用意念引導動作和勁力，呼吸自然。

· 連綿不斷：招式之間的轉換要圓活連貫，如行雲流水，一氣呵成。

# 二十六堂 \- 太極劍


Deepseek
好的，楊式太極劍的招式優美、舒展大方，兼具健身與防身的功能。其劍法特點是「以柔克剛」、「以巧制勝」，強調身劍合一，用意不用力。

以下是楊式太極劍的主要招式名稱，按照常見的練習順序排列，並附上簡要說明。

楊式太極劍主要招式（五十四式常見套路）

轉身，護腕。分手，發勁 。
預備式 & 起勢

1. 預備式：自然站立，心靜體鬆，劍持於左手中。
2. 起勢：開步、接劍，準備開始。

第一段（主要為進攻與基礎劍法）

1. 三環套月：一個標誌性的起勢動作，包含撥、攔、帶等劍法，劃出三個圓環。\(雙手伸出些，呈抱圓；左手劍彈出，然後定兩點；）
2. 魁星勢：獨立步平衡動作，姿勢優美如魁星點斗。（點刮抺，）
3. 燕子抄水：低姿僕步，劍身貼近地面向前穿出，輕靈如燕子掠水。
4. 右邊攔掃：轉身用劍刃向右方橫掃。（座劍，點劍，向上抺，劍刃向前，微斜向下後）
5. 左邊攔掃：接上式，向左方橫掃。
6. 小魁星：類似魁星勢，但動作較小。\(斜45度）
7. 燕子入巢：向後轉身，劍尖向下點刺。（順勢向下，兩點双交）
8. 靈貓捕鼠：躍步或跟步前刺，迅捷如貓。（弓步下刺）
9. 鳳凰抬頭：劍身向上崩起，格擋對方向上方的攻擊。
10. 黃蜂入洞：身體側閃，同時快速向前刺劍。（接上，45度）
11. 鳳凰右展翅：劍向右上方展開，身形舒展。（轉胯，翻腕，發勁）
12. 小魁星：重複動作。\(坐後45度
13. 鳳凰左展翅：劍向左上方展開。
14. 等魚式：蓄勢待發的姿勢，等待對方進攻。
15. 左右龍行勢：劍身左右擺動前進，如龍遊水中。
16. 宿鳥投林：獨立步，劍向前上方刺出，如鳥歸林。\(蹼步，然後上步）
17. 烏龍擺尾：劍尖向後下方點擊，身形轉動。（劍執穩，護膝）
18. 青龍出水：向前下方刺劍，勁力如水湧出。（右手平上，捲上弓步刺）
19. 風捲荷葉：劍身平抹，如風吹荷葉。（劍圈，翻腕，丁腳，轉身推，劍斜前）
20. 左獅子搖頭：劍尖從左向右搖晃劃圈，化開對方攻擊。（護身，四步）
21. 右獅子搖頭：從右向左搖晃劃圈。
22. 虎抱頭：劍身回收上舉，護於頭前，蓄力待發。
23. 野馬跳澗：跳步或快速跟步前刺，氣勢奔放。
24. 勒馬式：猛然收劍回帶，如勒馬韁。 \(後腳轉腳尖，拍向膊高）
25. 指南針：定勢向前平刺，劍如指南針般穩定。

第二段（更多轉身、平衡與複雜組合）

1. 左右迎風撢塵：連續的左右掛劍動作，如撢去灰塵。\(先反手，然後順時針轉270度，然後上步撢向對方的右肩\.\.\.，三下，翻劍，向左壓，轉腳尖，劍掃270度）
2. 順水推舟：向前進步推劍，借力打力。（弓步，抽劍，轉腳尖，丁步，提劍對敵喉嚨，弓止踏前）
3. 流星趕月：連續快速的點劍和刺劍。（轉腳尖，向後
4. 天馬行空：步伐輕靈，劍法飄逸。
5. 挑簾勢：由下向上挑劍，如挑門簾。
6. 左右車輪：劍在身體兩側劃立圓，如轉車輪。
7. 燕子銜泥：低姿點劍，輕巧準確。
8. 大鵬展翅：劍向斜下方展開，身形開闊。
9. 海底撈月：低姿由下向上撩劍。
10. 懷中抱月：收劍回抱，劍身橫於胸前。
11. 夜叉探海：獨立步，劍向前下方探刺。
12. 犀牛望月：回頭望月式，劍向後上方展出。
13. 射雁勢：虛步向前，劍向前下方點擊。
14. 青龍現爪：突然、短促的向前探刺。
15. 鳳凰雙展翅：劍向身體兩側展開，身形中正。
16. 左右跨欄：劍身做攔截對方攻擊的動作。
17. 射雁勢：重複動作。
18. 白猿獻果：托劍向前，如獻果狀。
19. 左右落花：連續向後退步，同時向左右下方掃劍。
20. 玉女穿梭：動作靈活多變，在四方移動穿梭。
21. 白虎攪尾：劍身快速在身後劃圈。
22. 魚跳龍門：躍步前刺，有跳躍過關之勢。
23. 烏龍絞柱：劍身貼近身體旋轉絞動。
24. 仙人指路：定勢向前平指（劍指）。
25. 朝天一柱香：劍身垂直立於身前。
26. 風掃梅花：身體旋轉一週，劍隨身走，掃向四周。
27. 牙笏式：收勢前的過渡，劍如古代官員的笏板。
28. 抱劍歸原：收劍，氣息歸元，回歸預備狀態。
29. 收勢：結束，放鬆還原。

楊式太極劍的主要劍法要點

· 劍法清晰：每招每式都要清楚地表現出劍法，如點、崩、刺、撩、劈、掛、攔、掃、抹、雲、帶、抽等。
· 身劍協調：強調「以身帶劍」，腰是主宰，帶動四肢運劍，做到「身劍合一」。
· 意氣相隨：練習時要精神集中，用意念引導動作和勁力，呼吸自然。
· 步法靈活：劍法與太極拳步法（如弓步、虛步、僕步、獨立步等）緊密配合，做到下盤穩固，上身輕靈。
· 連綿不斷：招式之間的轉換要圓活連貫，如行雲流水，一氣呵成。

# Just write, naturally
I have been thinking, if I keep thinking about writing a speech, it seems hard to get to the point what I want to speak. instead, I want to get the answer naturally.
Everyday, there are many things come across my mind. if I can use it, it shall not be difficult for me to write a speech. That would be more efficient than just focusing on writing a speech.

Good student: I am not good at asking question, I want to find the solution myself, that would be more interesting than getting the answer. However, when it come to speech, it required interaction, I need to get feedback to learn what is good or bad. Where I can improve.

If I like to subject, I can do it well... When the teacher is prettier, I normally would do the subject better. It didn't matter how well she taugh, what matter was the face... Art, Math, history... science. I was not a good student.
------------------------------
My family
No matter how bad your condition is, you shall attend the class. That's what I learnt from my mother. When I grew up, I rarely missed. - show up.
My father, drove us to different places (mainly to relative or friends places), brough me to swimming pool... while both of us didn't know how to swim...
My eldest brother -
my 2nd eldest brother - books, drawing
my 3rd elder brother - games, watch him playing, I was interesting in levelling up the characters
my elder sister -

Explore the books available at home. (三國演義，紅樓夢，金庸，漫畫）
borrow their clothes...

I'm the youngest.

---------------------
Nature
- beautiful photos in Hong Kong... many places in the world
- exercise (engage which muscle), running
- socializing,
- science (animal, plants, weathers)
-

--------------------
natural, 無為
not forceful. as it is.
focus is on improvement, not the speech.
- scientific progress - step by step
- failure is good.

broader view -
- not the game, but your strength
- not the performance of this one, but your overall development
- not this girl, but the whole forest...

Are there any chance that it is life changing?
- it is not normally nowaday. and if it is so important, you would naturally be focusing on the matter instead of yourself.
- nervous can't help. performce well only when you were relaxed
- if you busy at nervous, then you cannot focus on your performance.

F1, F4, ...

Flow
- drawing
- solving problems.

how about drama, all day?
- too easy
- no nutrition.
It is just like eating junk food, you can keep eating...

getting old....
----------------------------

when I see pretty woman, I would tend to look at them. But Confusious, 發乎情止乎禮. nowaday, when the women clothing are getting less and less coverage... the areas that I can naturally look at getting less and less...

--------------------------------
library
... HKUST, get a table with sea view beside a window.
study, review,
like the time when I was alone.

------------------------------
silence... focus... relax ... then fell asleep.
-- focus but relax, with intensity, deal with different situations.
- 鬆緊有度
----------------------------
what's the subject I want to investigate for my whole life?
- tai chi, Chinese philosophy (closer to my personality / nature)
- environment (what can I do? it seems that at the beginning I have nothing to do, but at least I won't regret).
- education
- accounting, engineering
- art
- math

regardless of success or failure. still want to do it.

--------------------------
Experiment, testing subject.

science - engineering - economic (scale) (business model)

Jennifer -

------------------------
to make noise.

-------------------

Breathing is important...
connect


-------------------
higher chance of being picked up...
... made me fear of joining meeting tonight...
table topic ..., oh table topic ... joining the contest.

to be relaxed.

energy recharge, tipping point, trading stocks.
--------------------
subjects that I learned. what can i do with the subjects？
although I have asked what I could do, there are still many possibility. It is just one of the possibilities.
what is important?

－－－－－－－－－－
two to tango. camaraderie
triangle.

foundation - interesting - snoring, maybe one day....

---------------------
doesn't matter, then I wouldn't do it. it matters, because
--\> tell myself that i'm excited, (not to tell myself I'm nervous or fear)

the goal is not to eliminate nervousness, but to manage it, do it in spite of it.

entries.text:
# Wish comes true
A few months ago, I rejioned Achievers and saw a photo shared by Kathy in our club social group\. It reminded me of a wish I had when I was young\.\.\. \(show the photo\)
 
My wish was to look older\.\.\. \(sigh\)
 
The photo was taken 17 years ago\.\.\. I was there\. 

The photo not only expose my age, but also made me depressed\.\.\.
 
Because when I returned to our meeting, many members said that \.\.\. I look the same\.\.\.

What's more, when I looked at our club flag at the entrance, and compare it 18 years ago, it has become a seasoned toastmaster flag\. Getting more wrinkle and wearing more the ribbons on it,\.\.\.  leaving trace of time that I can't even compare with\. 
 
I was depressed and reflected on what I have done wrong \.\.\. and summarize into 3 points\.  I hope that my speech can also be beneficial to you on making your wish come true\.
 
My first mistake was,
 
\- my wish was just a wish crossing my mind, no actionable plan\. Just like new year resolutions\. 
 
\- so I checked what is the cause of aging \.\.\. it is basically because of the damage of our cells that cannot be repaired\.
 
\.\.\. understanding the science, I can take appropriate actions\.\.\.
 
That lead me to find my second mistake\.\.\.
 
all the suggestions I got, is opposite to what I have been doing\. For examples:
 
\- ​**A diet high in processed foods, sugar, and unhealthy fats**​,\.\.\. I am not particularly interested in eating unnecessary foods, \.\.\. 
\- ​**drinking exceesive alcohol**​ \- my favorite drink are water\.\.\. and tea\.\.\. 
\- **Less Sleep** \- just like my computer, I can be turned into sleeping mode in a minute\.
\- **loneliness and social isolation** \.\.\. I just joined achievers\.\.\.  achievers are never lacking of connection \- can I abandon achievers? of course not, I just paid my membership fee, \.\.\.
 
all are in **conflict** with my current goals, and interests\.
 
Achieving something new is difficult, but as an achiever I believe \.\.\. every cloud has a silver lining \.\.\.
 
That lead me to my 3rd point\. If there are something that are in conflict with my current goals/ interest, there could be something the are a​++**ligned with \(in harmony\) my current goals / interests\. So that I do not need to sacrifice something and even achieve 2 goals at once\.**++​ 
 
- I am interested in woman, \.\.\. I can go to lan kwai fong, drinking alcohol and flirting with woman and staying late\.\.\.
- that's a promising and attractive goal \.\.\. 2 birds, one stone\. the problem is I don't know how to flirt with women\.\.\.
- ​++**So I need to Break it down, do it progressively \.\.\.**++​
- Join a toastmaster club, learn to have eye contact, smile and speak confidently and fluently, learn to praise people adequately\.\.\.
- \.\.\.\.

In conclusion, actionable plan, take action, eliminate the conflicts\. Start easy and step by step to achieve the ultimate goal\. 

I believe I will look older one day\.\.\. and I hope my reflection can also help you to make your wishes come true\.

entries.text:
My Trailwalker advice
Just a few points if you want to be faster:

1. It is preferable to keep walking\. No matter you are drinking or eating\.

No matter how slow it is\. It would be better than stop\. As it takes time to restart the engine\. And starting too fast would get injury easier\.

Don't stay and eat at any check point\.

It would be a big achievement itself if you can keep walking 100km\.

2. If you couldn't walk in fast pace from the beginning to the end\. You better not run until the last section\.

I tried in my training in my first year, since that time my IT Band was hurt\. I tried different ways not to induce the pain and still keep walking\. I found that keep walking itself is fast enough to complete in 24hr\.

3. Keep focus and feel every part of your body\. All the muscle, breathing and pace should be in sync with rhythm\.

Also feel the environment and make good use of it esp the gravity\.

4. Make each training a little more challenging than the last one\. And the purpose of training is to get stronger instead of getting faster\. As getting faster in one training doesn't necessarily mean you would be faster next time\.

So on training, don't choose the easier way\. And there may be some technique to help you save energy, e\.g\. Smaller step when walking uphill\. You may apply it on the Day, but you could choose to stride a larger step in your training\.

---

Just share my thoughts and experiences, which applied to me\.

# 三十四堂
10. 懷中抱月：收劍回抱，劍身橫於胸前。
11. 夜叉探海：獨立步，劍向前下方探刺。
12. 犀牛望月：回頭望月式，劍向後上方展出。
13. 射雁勢：虛步向前，劍向前下方點擊。

# 三十六堂
第二段（更多轉身、平衡與複雜組合）

1. 左右迎風撢塵：連續的左右掛劍動作，如撢去灰塵。\(先反手，然後順時針轉270度，然後上步撢向對方的右肩\.\.\.，三下，翻劍，向左壓，轉腳尖，劍掃270度）
2. 順水推舟：向前進步推劍，借力打力。（弓步，抽劍，轉腳尖，丁步，提劍對敵喉嚨，弓止踏前）
3. 流星趕月：連續快速的點劍和刺劍。（轉腳尖，向後
4. 天馬行空：步伐輕靈，劍法飄逸。
5. 挑簾勢：由下向上挑劍，如挑門簾。
6. 左右車輪：劍在身體兩側劃立圓，如轉車輪。
7. 燕子銜泥：低姿點劍，輕巧準確。
8. 大鵬展翅：劍向斜下方展開，身形開闊。
9. 海底撈月：低姿由下向上撩劍。
10. 懷中抱月：收劍回抱，劍身橫於胸前。
11. 夜叉探海：獨立步，劍向前下方探刺。
12. 犀牛望月：回頭望月式，劍向後上方展出。
13. 射雁勢：虛步向前，劍向前下方點擊。
14. 青龍現爪：突然、短促的向前探刺。
15. 鳳凰雙展翅：劍向身體兩側展開，身形中正。
16. 左右跨欄：劍身做攔截對方攻擊的動作。
17. 射雁勢：重複動作。
18. 白猿獻果：托劍向前，如獻果狀。
19. 左右落花：連續向後退步，同時向左右下方掃劍。
20. 玉女穿梭：動作靈活多變，在四方移動穿梭。
21. 白虎攪尾：劍身快速在身後劃圈。
22. 魚跳龍門：躍步前刺，有跳躍過關之勢。
23. 烏龍絞柱：劍身貼近身體旋轉絞動。
24. 仙人指路：定勢向前平指（劍指）。
25. 朝天一柱香：劍身垂直立於身前。
26. 風掃梅花：身體旋轉一週，劍隨身走，掃向四周。
27. 牙笏式：收勢前的過渡，劍如古代官員的笏板。
28. 抱劍歸原：收劍，氣息歸元，回歸預備狀態。
29. 收勢：結束，放鬆還原。

entries.text:
# I am not a woman
2 weeks ago, I heard a table topic response from our new member, Victor, saying, he was not a funny guy, couldn't give funny question\. 

This statement inspire me that ==i am not a woman, no wonder I couldn't get a girlfriend\.== 

==It was long ago, when I were not a woman, and not even a man, but an innocent boy,== 
I thought everything were simple\. 

in the first year of secondary school, I read a manga, called \- "Touch", it is a story baseball\. It had a **training menu** \- including doing push up 50 times, sit up 50 times\. twice a day\. I didn't play baseball, but as a boy I did arm wrestling with classmates and interested in bodybuilding\. So I tried the training menu, I do it when I was free, normally during advertising period when I was watching TV\. That year PE class final test was ​**fitness test**​\. Two of the tests were doing push up and sit up in 15 seconds\.\.\. I did 30 times push up \.\.\.\. so I came first in the year\.

In the next year, I watched a TV programme, it taught about painting\. It amazed me how a **beautiful painting** can be created so effortlessly\. I felt for that\. For every assignment in art and design class in school, I would try all the skills I learnt from the TV, and from books borrowed from library\. I forgot about time, do it from day to night, just absorbed in it, made many drafts before final pieces\. \.\.\. so I got the first place in the year\.

In the following year, I ​**felt for a girl**​\. I thought about her from day to night\.  ​==When I saw her back, wanted to see her front; when I saw her external appearance, wanted to see her in\.\.\. inner heart\.==​ ==That year\.\., I got a “good student” remark from her, and literally meant I was rejected\.== "I hated to be good student\."

​++**"If I were a woman, I might know more about her \.\.\. and get her heart "**++​ 

==But if I were a woman, I probably would not be interested in a woman\.==

It made me thought, it is ​**the same interest**​, I didn't think my interest in a girl would be less than that of sport or art\. So what are the difference?

When I compare the difference, it seems that I **Focused on the wrong thing\.**  For sport or art, I'm interested in the process, as much as even more than the result; but for a relationship, I was trapped that it was all or nothing\. My fear of failure stop me from taking any concrete action\. It had no process at all, just ending\. \.\.\. rarely speak, and even eye contact \.\.\. without action, there is no feedback, and no improvement\. 

How can I overcome my fear? ​==After being an==​ ​**==accountant==**​​==, I understand more about cost and benefit\. I found that being rejected was a good thing\.==​ 
  1\.   it meant that she can live happier without me\. In a relationship, I do wish a person has a happy life;
  2\.   ​==it costs me nothing==​\. I do not need to spend time on her anymore\. I can focus on ==being a better person, getting a better girlfriend\.\.\.==
==it is a win\-win situation\.==

Fellow toastmaster and guests, I'm not a woman, nor a good speaker\. But it would not stop me from getting a girlfriend or being a better speaker\.

Because I like that or want to do that\. And would do something on that\. 

How about you?
